BPHS1_deep.text: Indications of houses from 1st to 12th, prosperity or annihilation of a house.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Effects of the 12 bhava lords in various houses (total 144 combinations), clues to sort out mutually contradictory effects.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: 8th from Karakamsa

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: I have adopted a scientific method for deductions for planetary contributions arising by placement in houses 12 to 7. I have simply not considered house positions in these deductions but degree-wise positions of the various planets. I have given one common formula covering the six houses and the reader can work out the exact loss of longevity. This can be usefully extended to any loss of years as far as houses 12 to 7 is concerned in other systems as well.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Note the signs which are the 4th, 2nd, 12th, 5th, 9th and the 8th from the Moolatrikona of a planet. The planets ruling such signs are its friends, apart from the lord of its exaltation sign. Lords other than these are its enemies. If a planet becomes its friend as well as its enemy (on account of the said two computations) then it is neutral or equal.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: A simple formula is given in this sloka to compute planetary relationships. From the Moolatrikona sign of a planet, the 2nd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 9th and 12th lords are its friends. The rest viz. 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th and 11th lords from Moolatrikona are its enemies. The exaltation sign's lord is always friendly even if he owns the 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th or the 11th from Moolatrikona. If, however, friendship and enmity occur simultaneously none prevails but equality or neutrality.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If a planet in the 8th is in 'Payodhi' shashtiamsa, fear from water may be expected.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The 2nd, 5th, 8th and the 11th are Panapharas or succedents.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Evil houses or Trika houses are the 6th, 8th and the 12th.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Chaturasras are the 4th and 8th.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The 12 houses are: Thanu, Dhana, Sahaja, Bandhu, Putra, Ari, Yuvati, Randhra, Dharma, Karma, Labha and Vyaya are in order the names of houses.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Randhra: longevity

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Randhra actually means a vulnerable or assailable point. A planet in the 8th becomes vulnerably placed.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: O Brahmin, first of all, estimate the evils and checking factors thereof through the ascendant and then declare the effects of the 12 bhavas.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: EIGHTH HOUSE: The 8th house indicates longevity, battle, enemies, forts, wealth of the dead and things that have happened and are to happen (in the past and future births).

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Should the lord of the 2nd be in the 8th, financial conditions will decline.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: The lords of the 2nd and 11th can be jointly in the 6th/8th/12th or individually disposed in any two of the said three houses. Simultaneously, the 2nd house needs a malefic in it. Thus there are afflictions from three directions which will make the native extremely poor. Even food is denied to one having combust 2nd lord and combust 11th lord. Alternatively.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Should the said planet [2nd lord] be in the 6th, 8th or 12th, there will be disease or deformity of eyes.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 5th lord is in the 6th, 9th or the 12th or be in an inimical sign or be in fall or in the 8th itself, the native will beget issues with difficulty.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: ULCERS/BRUISES: Should the 6th lord be in the 6th house itself, or in the ascendant/8th house, there will be ulcers or bruises on the body. The sign becoming the 6th house will lead to the knowledge of the concerned limb.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Should the ascen- dant lord be ip his sign of debilitation as the 2nd lord is in the Eth, loss of wife will occur in the l3th year of age.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: O excellent of the Bratrmins, listen to me speaking on the effects of the 8th house. If the 8th lord is in an angle, long life is indicated.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Should the 8th lord join the ascendant lord and be in the 8th itself, the native will be short-lived.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Should the 8th lord join a malefic and be in the 8th itself, the native will be short-lived.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The 8th lord is in the 8th along wjth a malefic

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The 8th lord is in the 8th along with the ascendant lord

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The l0th lord is in the 8th along with a malefic planet

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: if the 6th lord and l2th lord are in the ascendant and the 8th.

BPHS1_deep.text:
There will be no gains in spite of numerous efforts if
the llth lord is in fall, incombustion or be in the 6th/gth/12th
with a malefrc.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text:
And if the t2th lord is in the 6th/gth or be in enemy,s

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the ascendant lord is in the 8th, the native will be an accomplished scholar, be sickly, thievish, be given to much anger, be a gambler and will join others' wives.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The only good effect of the ascendant lord being in the 8th house is one's academic accomplishment. This position will cause Balarishta or child mortality. The native's health will be poor. He will be a repository of misfortunes. He will see many deaths in the family to his grief. His married life will be a hell. He will be a profligate and will incur ill-fame and disrepute, penury will ever be after him.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 2nd lord is in the 8th, the native will be endowed with abundant land and wealth. But he will have limited marital felicity and be bereft of happiness from his elder brother.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 3rd lord is ii the 8th, the native will be a thief' wiliderive his livelihood serving others and will die at tho gatc of royal palace.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 5th lord is in the 8th, the native will not have much progenic happiness, be troubled by cough and pulmonary disorders, be given to anger and be devoid of happiness.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be devoid of bodily vigour, will enjoy a little wealth and will not regain lost wealth.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be devoid of fraternal happiness, he indolent and devoid of servants and strength.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 4th, the child will be deprived of its mother. He will be devoid of a house, lands and happiness and will doubtlessly betray his friends.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 5th, the native will be dull-witted, will have limited number of children, be longlived and wealthy.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 6th, the native will win over his enemies, be afflicted by diseases and during childhood will incur danger through snakes and water.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 7th, the native will have two wives.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is conjunct a malefic in the 7th there will surely be downfall in his business (or livelihood).

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 8th the native will be long-lived.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the said planet (8th lord) be weak being in the 8th, the longevity will be medium, while the native will be a thief, be blameworthy and will blame others well.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 10th, the native will be devoid of fraternal bliss, be a tale-bearer and be bereft of livelihood. If there is an aspect in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature. Notes: There is a school of thought to say that the 8th lord occupying the 9th house will cause the deaths of parents right in the native's boyhood. Apparently one will not enjoy parental happiness for a long duration. This placement of the 8th lord will produce all kinds of miseries in livelihood, fortunes, fame, properties and the like. According to Maharshi Parasara, if the 8th lord in the 10th house is (well) related to a benefic, no evils will come to pass.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 12th, the native will spend on evil deeds and will incur a short life. More so, if there be additionally a malefic in the said house.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: A planet in an angle gets full strength while one in succedent house gets half and the one in cadent house gets a quarter (of Rupa) (as Kendradi bala). Kendradi means angles etc. This denotes three groups of four Rasis each. These are angles (i.e., 1st, 4th, 7th and 10th), succedents (i.e., 2nd, 5th, 8th and 11th), and cadents (i.e., 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th). The following are the Kendradi balas: (1) Planet in angle: 60 Virupas (2) Planet in succedent: 30 Virupas (3) Planet in cadent: 15 Virupas

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: In calculating the Arudhas for the various houses, we have to proceed as under. First of all we understand the 12 Arudhas thus : 1. Lagna Pada (or simply Pada) 2. Dhana Pada 3. Vikrama (Bhratru) Pada 4. Matru (Sukha) Pada 5. Mantra or Putra Pada 6. Roga or Satru Pada 7. Dara Pada (Kalatra Pada) 8. Marana Pada 9. Pitru Pada 10. Karma Pada 11. Labha Pada 12. Vyaya Pada

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the Dara Pada falls in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Lagna Pada, then the native will be poor.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Similarly, aspect on the 2nd house denotes acquisition of wealth and grains; on the 3rd house, happiness from co-born; on the 4th house, residences, quadrupeds, and relatives; on the 5th house, sons, grandsons, and intelligence; on the 6th house, fear from enemies; on the 7th house, abundant wealth and marital happiness; on the 8th house, difficulties; on the 9th house, fortunes; on the 10th house, royal honor; on the 11th house, gains; and on the 12th house, expenses.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: 8th house (longevity)

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: O excellent of the Brahmins, after knowing the merits of the 1st house etc. the good and bad effects be declared. 8th, 6th, 2nd and 12th are malefic bhavas. Association with these houses will inflict evils. Angles and Trines are auspicious bhavas, the association with which turns even evils into auspiciousness.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: The 6 bhavas viz. 11th, 3rd, 8th, 6th, 2nd and 12th; adverse: A planet owning or occupying one of the said houses will become a functional malefic and hence adversary. The other 6 bhavas, viz. ascendant, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th and 10th are good houses. Planets associated with these houses prove favourable although by nature evil or adverse. Also see ch. 34 for more information.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The effects due to the lords of the 12th, and 8th will depend on their association.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The 8th lord is not auspicious as he owns the 12th from the 9th.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th simultaneously owns the 3rd, 7th or 11th, he will prove specifically harmful

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: his simultaneous ownership of a trine will bestow auspicious effects.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Lords of 3rd, 6th and 11th are classified as evil planets while the lords of 2nd, 12th and 8th wifi act according to association.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: One having benefics in angles/trines as malefics are in 3rd, 6th and 11th will obtain Super-natural life span (one thousand years). The 8th house in this case should be one of benefic-owned signs.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If at birth 3 planets are exalted, out of which the lords of ascendant and 8th are inclusive, as the 8th is devoid of a malefic in it, full life span will result.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: Long life is denoted if 3 planets are in the 8th, in exaltation, own/friendly divisions while the ascendant lord is strong.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 6th, 7th and 8th are occupied by benefics while malefics are in 3rd and 11th, full life span will follow the birth.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: O excellent of the Brahmins, if a malefic is in the 8th while the 10th lord is exalted, one will be long-lived.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The stronger among the ascendant lord and the 8th lord if in an angle will confer long life and if in Panaphara (2nd, 5th, 8th or 11th) medium life. If the said planet be in Apoklima (3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th) short life will come to pass. According to the ascendant lord being friendly, neutral or

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: For the information of the reader, the Maraka planets in the ascending are: occupants or lords of 12th, 3rd, 8th, 7th and 2nd.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS1_deep.text: The 2nd house is naturally added as another node will be in the 2nd when one is in the specified 8th house.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: I have adopted a scientific method for deductions for planetary contributions arising by placement in houses 12 to 7. I have simply not considered house positions in these deductions but degree-wise positions of the various planets. I have given one common formula covering the six houses and the reader can work out the exact loss of longevity. This can be usefully extended to any loss of years as far as houses 12 to 7 is concerned in other systems as well.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: A simple formula is given in this sloka to compute planetary relationships. From the Moolatrikona sign of a planet, the 2nd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 9th and 12th lords are its friends. The rest viz. 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th and 11th lords from Moolatrikona are its enemies. The exaltation sign's lord is always friendly even if he owns the 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th or the 11th from Moolatrikona. If, however, friendship and enmity occur simultaneously none prevails but equality or neutrality.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: The planet posited in the 10th, 4th, 11th, 3rd, 2nd or the 12th from another becomes mutual friend.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: If two are mutually in 4th and 10th, or in 3rd and 11th or in 2nd and 12th, they become temporarily cordial to each other. Should they be otherwise, there prevails mutual temporary enmity.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: The Kendras (angles) are specially known as ascendant, the 4th house, the 7th and the mid-heaven (the 10th house).

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: The 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th houses are Upachaya.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: The 12 houses are: Thanu, Dhana, Sahaja, Bandhu, Putra, Ari, Yuvati, Randhra, Dharma, Karma, Labha and Vyaya are in order the names of houses.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: Karma: acts (or livelihood)

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: O Brahmin, first of all, estimate the evils and checking factors thereof through the ascendant and then declare the effects of the 12 bhavas.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: The area of the horoscope from the 4th cusp to the 10th cusp via the 7th house is known as occidcntal (or western) half while the rest half is oricntal (or eastern) half.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 4th, 10th and 12th are all occupied by malefics, both the parents will leave the child to its own fate and wander from place to place.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: TENTH HOUSE: Royalty (authority), place, profession (livelihood), honour, father, living in foreign lands and debts are to be understood from the 10th house.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: "Father" is to be studied through the 10th house, as per the above shloka. The sage obviously refers to the 10th in this context as the 10th is the 7th from the 4th. Western astrologers too follow this view. Here we need some elaboration. The status of the father, his family (i.e. consisting of the native's mother etc.), and the final rites the native will perform to his father will all have to be known through the 10th house. The father as an individual and his well being etc. be examined from the 9th house. The sage also discusses the father with reference to the 9th house in one of the ensuing chapters. Thus it follows that both the 9th and 10th are primary houses related to father.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 10

If a planet becomes its friend as well as its enemy (on account of the said two computations) then it is neutral or equal.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 8

The exaltation sign's lord is always friendly even if he owns the 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th or the 11th from Moolatrikona. If, however, friendship and enmity occur simultaneously none prevails but equality or neutrality.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

If a planet becomes its friend as well as its enemy (on account of the said two computations) then it is neutral or equal.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: A simple formula is given in this sloka to compute planetary relationships. From the Moolatrikona sign of a planet, the 2nd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 9th and 12th lords are its friends. The rest viz. 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th and 11th lords from Moolatrikona are its enemies. The exaltation sign's lord is always friendly even if he owns the 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th or the 11th from Moolatrikona. If, however, friendship and enmity occur simultaneously none prevails but equality or neutrality.

BPHS1_deep.text: I have adopted a scientific method for deductions for planetary contributions arising by placement in houses 12 to 7. I have given one common formula covering the six houses and the reader can work out the exact loss of longevity. This can be usefully extended to any loss of years as far as houses 12 to 7 is concerned in other systems as well.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: Note the signs which are the 4th, 2nd, 12th, 5th, 9th and the 8th from the Moolatrikona of a planet. The planets ruling such signs are its friends, apart from the lord of its exaltation sign. Lords other than these are its enemies. If a planet becomes its friend as well as its enemy (on account of the said two computations) then it is neutral or equal.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes: A simple formula is given in this sloka to compute planetary relationships. From the Moolatrikona sign of a planet, the 2nd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 9th and 12th lords are its friends. The rest viz. 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th and 11th lords from Moolatrikona are its enemies. The exaltation sign's lord is always friendly even if he owns the 3rd, 6th, 7th, 10th or the 11th from Moolatrikona. If, however, friendship and enmity occur simultaneously none prevails but equality or neutrality.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the ascendant lord is in the 9th, the native will be fortunate, dear to people, be a devotee of Sri Vishnu, be skilful, eloquent in speech and be endowed with wife, sons and wealth.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: One will gain abundantly from his father. Every undertaking of his will be fruitful. He will be well-disposed to his co-born, These are additional results of the ascendant lord occupying the 9th house.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 2nd lord is in the 9th, the native will be wealthy, diligent, skilful, sick during childhood and will later on be happy (i.e. healthy) and will visit shrines, observing religious code etc.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 3rd lord is in the 9th, the native will lack paternhl bliss, will make fortunes through wife and will enily progenic and other Pleasures. Notes : Although one rnay have fortunes and progpnic happiness, one will unendingly feel miserable if the 3rd lord occupi.s the 9th house. His father will be a contemptiblc person.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: Notes : Maharshi Parasara enunciates four different possibilities if the 5th lord is in the 6th house. 1. Obtaining sons that will be inimical to the native : The 6th house denotes one's enemies. The planet occupying the 6th will signify the class of enemy. 5th lord indicates sons, 9th lord indicates father, 4th lord indicates mother and so on and so forth. Such relative will be inimical to the native corresponding to the rulership of the occupant of the 6th house. 2. Loss of children : The 6th is the maraka sthana for children as it is the 2nd from the 5th. Hence loss of progeny is denoted. 3.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: It is also not advisable for a female to have her 9th lord in the 10th house from the point of view of filial happiness.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 8th lord is in the 10th, the native will be devoid of fraternal bliss, be a tale-bearer and be bereft of livelihood. If there is an aspect in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature. Notes: There is a school of thought to say that the 8th lord occupying the 9th house will cause the deaths of parents right in the native's boyhood. Apparently one will not enjoy parental happiness for a long duration. This placement of the 8th lord will produce all kinds of miseries in livelihood, fortunes, fame, properties and the like. According to Maharshi Parasara, if the 8th lord in the 10th house is (well) related to a benefic, no evils will come to pass.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: EFFECTS OF THE 9TH LORD IN VARIOUS HOUSES (up to sloka ths) : If the 9th lord is in the ascendant, the native will be fortunate (or prosperous), will be honoured by the king, be virtuous, dharmic, learned and honoured by the public. Notes: If the 9th lord is in the rising sign, the native will hold a very high position which will bring him wealth and fame. He will be free from enemies. A female having the said position will prove a worthy housewife and be rid of afflictions from other planetary sources. (These effects will not be enjoyed by a Scorpio native.)

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 9th lord is in the 2nd, the native will be a scholar, be dear to all, wealthy, sensuous and endowed with happiness from wife, sons etc.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 9th lord is in the 3rd, the native will be endowed with fraternal bliss, be wealthy, virtuous and charming.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: If the 9th lord is in the 12th, the native will incur loss of fortunes, will always spend on auspicious acts and will become poor on account of entertaining guests.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: A planet in an angle gets full strength while one in succedent house gets half and the one in cadent house gets a quarter (of Rupa) (as Kendradi bala). Kendradi means angles etc. This denotes three groups of four Rasis each. These are angles (i.e., 1st, 4th, 7th and 10th), succedents (i.e., 2nd, 5th, 8th and 11th), and cadents (i.e., 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th). The following are the Kendradi balas: (1) Planet in angle: 60 Virupas (2) Planet in succedent: 30 Virupas (3) Planet in cadent: 15 Virupas

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: In calculating the Arudhas for the various houses, we have to proceed as under. First of all we understand the 12 Arudhas thus : 1. Lagna Pada (or simply Pada) 2. Dhana Pada 3. Vikrama (Bhratru) Pada 4. Matru (Sukha) Pada 5. Mantra or Putra Pada 6. Roga or Satru Pada 7. Dara Pada (Kalatra Pada) 8. Marana Pada 9. Pitru Pada 10. Karma Pada 11. Labha Pada 12. Vyaya Pada

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS1_deep.text: Similarly, aspect on the 2nd house denotes acquisition of wealth and grains; on the 3rd house, happiness from co-born; on the 4th house, residences, quadrupeds, and relatives; on the 5th house, sons, grandsons, and intelligence; on the 6th house, fear from enemies; on the 7th house, abundant wealth and marital happiness; on the 8th house, difficulties; on the 9th house, fortunes; on the 10th house, royal honor; on the 11th house, gains; and on the 12th house, expenses.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

The other 6 bhavas, viz. ascendant, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th and 10th are good houses. Planets associated with these houses prove favourable although by nature evil or adverse. Also see ch. 34 for more information.

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

BPHS1_deep.subject: House 9

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: When the 4th Lord happens to be placed in the 8th House, the native will be devoid of domestic and other comforts, will not get much paternal happiness and be equal to a neuter.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 5th Lord being relegated to the 8th House, the native will have less progenic happiness; will be troubled by cough and pulmonary or respiratory diseases, be given to anger and be devoid of happiness.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 6th Lord falling in the 8th House, the native will be sickly, inimical to the learned and the wise, will desire others' wealth be interested in others' wives and be impure.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 7th Lord happens to fall in the 8th House, the native will be bereft of marital happiness. His wife also will be afflicted by diseases, bad-natured and will not remain obedient to the native.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The native born in Gemini Ascendant will certainly get the effects described in the sloka. In this horoscope the Ascendant is Gemini. The 7th Lord, being placed in the 8th House is situated in his sign of debilitation. This is the horoscope of a woman whose virginity was violated by her teacher. After marriage she was divorced by her husband. The marital life could not be happy even after contracting another marriage. She was divorced again within a year of the 2nd marriage.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord happens to be placed in the Ascendant the native will be bereft of bodily pleasures, be detractor of gods and Brahmins and will have wounds.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is placed in the 2nd House, the native will be devoid of physical vigour will possess little weallth and will not regain lost wealth.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 8th Lord is gone in the 3rd House, the native will be devoid of fraternal happiness, be indolent, devoid of vigour and without servants.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: When the 8th Lord occupies the 4th House the native will be deprived of his mother and there can be no doubt in it that he will be devoid of a house, lands and, happiness and will be a betrayer of friends.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord happens to fall in the 5th House the native will be dull witted. He will have a few children and be longlived and wealthy.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 8th Lord is gone in the 6th House, the native will win over his opponents, will have a diseased body and in childhood he will fear danger through Snakes and water.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is placed in the 7th House, the native will have two wives and if he is in conjunction with a malefic planet also, there will certainly be loss in his trade.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 8th Lord occupy the 8th House, the native will be long lived. If he (the 8th Lord) is weak, longevity will be medium and the native will be a thief, be blameworthy himself and will blame others as well.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The situation of the 8th Lord in the 8th House, that is his situation in his own House in not sufficient, he must be endowed with strength in shadabala. If he be weak in shadabala the longevity will be medium (32 to 64 years).

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is situated in the 9th House, the native will be a betrayer of his religion and a heterodox; he will be the husband of a wicked wife and will steal other's wealth.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord occupies the 10th House the native will not have paternal bliss, will be a talebearer and be bereft of livelihood. If there is an aspect in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 8th lord be placed in the 11th House, the native will be devoid of wealth, be miserable in boyhood, but happy in later life, and if the 8th lord be in conjunction with a benefic, be long lived.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord be situated in the 12th House the native will squander his wealth on evil deeds, be short lived; more so if he in is in conjunction with a malefic planet.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 9th Lord is gone in the 8th House, the native will be devoid of fortune, and he will not have the happiness of an elder brother.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 10th Lord is a posited in the 8th House, the native will be devoid of good acts, long lived and intent on blaming others. If the native adopts the profession of dealing in scraps, mineral substances, L.I.C., leather goods, etc. he will get special success, otherwise he fails badly in his profession. Some natives have been found to be engaged in immoral professions also

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord is placed in the 12th House, the native will spend in royal courts. He will also have fear from enemies and will be worried inspite of being skilful. When the 10th Lord happens to fall in the 6th, 8th and 12th House, the native mostly gets troubles from the royal side. In case the 10th Lord is fallen in the 12th House, the native has to spend much money on the king or for the state. This effect is generally seen in greater degree in the case of natives having Taurus and Scorpio Ascendants.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 11th Lord is fallen in the 8th House, the native will suffer losses in his undertakings. He will be long lived while his wife will die before him.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: There will be gains in the dealings of scrap, leather, and mineral substances in all the Ascendants.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 4th Lord occupy the 10th house, the native will enjoy royal honours, be an alchemist, be extremely pleased, will have pleasures and will be conqueror of his five senses.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: A native having this combination in his horoscope will do trade in things related to the 4th House and his trade is highly successful also. Following are the trades or professions related to the 4th House: Dairy farm, piggery, automobile, building construction, building material, civil engineering and agriculture etc. The natives having Gemini Ascendant will experience some difficulties in their profession because in this Ascendant the 4th Lord being placed in the 10th House, will be debilitated.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 6th Lord occupy the 10th House the native will be illustrious in his family, will not be a devoted son, be a gifted speaker, and be happy in foreign countries.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The 6th is the House which represents chemistry, enemies, quarrels and fights and diseases. Therefore the relation of the 6th and the 10th House will make the native study chemistry, military science, law and medicine etc. and will give him professions related to these subjects.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 7th Lord being placed in the 10th House, the native's wife will not remain under his control. The native himself will be religious and be gifted with Wealth, sons etc.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord occupies the 10th House the native will not have paternal bliss, will be a talebearer and be bereft of livelihood. If there is an aspect in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 9th Lord is placed in the 10th House, the native will be a king or equal to a King, or be a minister or an army chief, be virtuous and be worshipped by all.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 10th Lord be situated in the 4th House, the native will enjoy happiness, be devoted to his mother, and be interested in her welfare, will have conveyances, lands and houses, be virtuous and wealthy.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In Virgo and Pisces Ascendants the situation will specially bring auspicious effects, because in these Ascendants the 10th Lords will be in their own signs in the Ascendant.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord occupies the 2nd House, the native will be wealthy, virtuous, honoured by the King (or the Government), charitable and endowed with paternal and other bliss.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord is situated in the 3rd House, the native will enjoy happiness from brothers and servants, be valorous, virtuous eloquent and truthful.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the Capricorn Ascendant this combination prompts the native to become an engineer.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In this combination the native mostly adopts a profession relating to automobiles, building material, agriculture, dairy etc.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 10th Lord being placed in the 5th House, the native will be endowed with all kinds of learning, be always cheerful, wealthy and be blessed with sons.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: According to this sloka an angle, the 10th House, gets related to a trine, the 5th House. This combination, therefore, is specially auspicious. In it the native earns great fame on the basis of his intellectual powers and is very successful in his field of action. This combination is generally found in the horoscopes of wise statesmen, scholars, professors, writers, educationists, actors etc.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 10th Lord is fallen in the 6th House, the native will be bereft of paternal bliss, be bereft of wealth and be troubled by enemies, inspite of being skilful.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: This combination is auspicious only for Doctors and lawyers. In the case of men of other professions, many fluctuations are experienced and the natives in this combination encounter many obstacles.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord occupies the 7th House, the native will get happiness through wife, be intelligent, virtuous, eloquent, truthful and devoted to religion.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 10th Lord be placed in the 10th House, the native will be skilful in all jobs, be valorous, truthful and devoted to his teachers and elders.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord is situated in the 11th House, the native is blessed with wealth and, sons. He will enjoy happiness, be truthful, be always delighted and be virtuous

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 11th Lord be situated in the 10th House, the native will be honoured by the king, be virtuous, devoted to his religion, truthful and subdue his senses.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The same thing will hold true in the case of a native born in the Scorpio Ascendant (regarding not considering fair or foul means for income with 11th Lord in 10th).

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 10
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 12th Lord is situated in the 10th House, the native will rise through royal persons and will enjoy only moderate paternal bliss.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: When the 4th Lord happens to be placed in the 8th House, the native will be devoid of domestic and other comforts, will not get much paternal happiness and be equal to a neuter.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 5th Lord being relegated to the 8th House, the native will have less progenic happiness; will be troubled by cough and pulmonary or respiratory diseases, be given to anger and be devoid of happiness.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 6th Lord falling in the 8th House, the native will be sickly, inimical to the learned and the wise, will desire others' wealth be interested in others' wives and be impure.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 7th Lord happens to fall in the 8th House, the native will be bereft of marital happiness. His wife also will be afflicted by diseases, bad-natured and will not remain obedient to the native.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The native born in Gemini Ascendant will certainly get the effects described in the sloka. In this horoscope the Ascendant is Gemini. The 7th Lord, being placed in the 8th House is situated in his sign of debilitation. This is the horoscope of a woman whose virginity was violated by her teacher. After marriage she was divorced by her husband. The marital life could not be happy even after contracting another marriage. She was divorced again within a year of the 2nd marriage.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord happens to be placed in the Ascendant the native will be bereft of bodily pleasures, be detractor of gods and Brahmins and will have wounds.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is placed in the 2nd House, the native will be devoid of physical vigour will possess little weallth and will not regain lost wealth.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 8th Lord is gone in the 3rd House, the native will be devoid of fraternal happiness, be indolent, devoid of vigour and without servants.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: When the 8th Lord occupies the 4th House the native will be deprived of his mother and there can be no doubt in it that he will be devoid of a house, lands and, happiness and will be a betrayer of friends.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord happens to fall in the 5th House the native will be dull witted. He will have a few children and be longlived and wealthy.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 8th Lord is gone in the 6th House, the native will win over his opponents, will have a diseased body and in childhood he will fear danger through Snakes and water.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is placed in the 7th House, the native will have two wives and if he is in conjunction with a malefic planet also, there will certainly be loss in his trade.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 8th Lord occupy the 8th House, the native will be long lived. If he (the 8th Lord) is weak, longevity will be medium and the native will be a thief, be blameworthy himself and will blame others as well.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The situation of the 8th Lord in the 8th House, that is his situation in his own House in not sufficient, he must be endowed with strength in shadabala. If he be weak in shadabala the longevity will be medium (32 to 64 years).

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is situated in the 9th House, the native will be a betrayer of his religion and a heterodox; he will be the husband of a wicked wife and will steal other's wealth.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord occupies the 10th House the native will not have paternal bliss, will be a talebearer and be bereft of livelihood. If there is an aspect in the process from a benefic, then these evils will not mature.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 8
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: There will be gains in the dealings of scrap, leather, and mineral substances in all the Ascendants.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 4th Lord has gone in the 7th House the native will be highly learned in various branches of knowledge, will be apt to leave his paternal property, and will be akin to the dumb in an assembly.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Such a native lacks the capability of expressing his feelings and ideas. Particularly in assemblies etc. he finds himself unable to express his ideas. He does not have the greed of paternal property. He can gladly leave it if he has to leave it in the interest of a member of his family. He finds some person that can bear the responsibility of his family. He (that person) may be the native's father or brother. In the Libra and Capricorn Ascendants, being in the 7th House, the 4th Lords falls in his sign of debilitation. Natives having these Ascendants lead an unquiet married life. Before marriage there is the breaking of the engagement and after marriage, there comes the possibility of getting divorce. The native gets some disease relating to the urinary tract or his kidney may become sickly.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 5th Lord is situated in the 7th House, the native will be tolerant of all religions and very religious, endowed with progenic happiness and be helpful to others.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 6th Lord is situated in the 4th House the native will be devoid of maternal happiness, be intelligent, be a talebearer, be jealous, fickleminded and very rich.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 6th Lord is placed in the 7th House, it means that the native and his spouse will not have smooth relations between them and they remian in constant tension, quarrelling and fighting. As a consequence their married life becomes hellish. In the Aries and Libra Ascendants it is the errors of the native himself which cause disharmony in relations because in these Ascendants the 6th Lord will become the 3rd Lord also due to which the native will tend to do deeds of enmity deliberately.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 7th Lord happens to fall in the 8th House, the native will be bereft of marital happiness. His wife also will be afflicted by diseases, bad-natured and will not remain obedient to the native.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 7th Lord is placed in the 2nd House the native will have many wives, will gain wealth through his wife and will be of procastinating nature.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 7th Lord is situated in the 3rd House, the issue of the native are subjected to (early) death. Sometimes a daughter is born and a son may also remain living with great difficulty.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: This effect occurs with great cruelty in the case of Taurus Ascendant. The main reason for this is the sickness of the spouse, and the native himself due to sexual perversity etc gets his sexual capacity decayed. This effect is not found in the case of Leo and Aquarius Ascendants because in these Ascendants the 7th Lord will be exalted in the 3rd House.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 7th Lord is situated in the 6th House or is in conjunction with the 6th Lord, the native generally gets divorced from his spouse. In this situation wife and husband remain in great tension. If the intermediaries in the marriage were maternal uncle or aunt, then this situation doesnot arise. In the Aries Ascendant the effect of divorce is fructified very soon.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 7th Lord occupy the 5th House the native will be a man of honour, gifted with all the virtues, always delighted and endowed with all kinds of wealth.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 7th Lord is placed in the 6th House, the native's wife will be sickly or the native is inimical towards her, he is himself given to anger and remains devoid of happiness.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 7th Lord occupy the 7th House the native will be endowed with happiness through wife, be courageous, skilful and intelligent but only afflicted by windy diseases.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: The native born in Gemini Ascendant will certainly get the effects described in the sloka. In this horoscope the Ascendant is Gemini. The 7th Lord, being placed in the 8th House is situated in his sign of debilitation. This is the horoscope of a woman whose virginity was violated by her teacher. After marriage she was divorced by her husband. The marital life could not be happy even after contracting another marriage. She was divorced again within a year of the 2nd marriage.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: It the 7th Lord is situated in the 9th House, the native will have union with many women, be well disposed to his own wife, and will initiate a number of deeds.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In the event of the 7th Lord being placed in the 10th House, the native's wife will not remain under his control. The native himself will be religious and be gifted with Wealth, sons etc.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 7th Lord occupies the 11th House the native will gain wealth through his wife, will get less happiness from his sons and will have more daughters (than sons).

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 7th Lord is gone in the 12th House, the native will be penurious, miserly, and his wife will be spendthrift. He will earn his livelihood by trading in Clothes(textiles/garments etc).

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is placed in the 7th House, the native will have two wives and if he is in conjunction with a malefic planet also, there will certainly be loss in his trade.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 9th Lord is placed in the 7th House, the native will get happiness through his wife. He will be virtuous and famous.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the Ascendant is Scorpio or Virgo, the 9th Lord, being placed in the 7th House, will be in his sign of exaltation in both the cases, and the native will get excellent effects.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord occupies the 7th House, the native will get happiness through wife, be intelligent, virtuous, eloquent, truthful and devoted to religion.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 11th Lord is situated in the 7th House, the native always gains through his wife's relatives. He will be liberal, virtuous, sensual and will remain at the command of his wife.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 7
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 12th Lord occupy the 7th House, the native will always expend on account of his wife, will not enjoy conjugal bliss and will be bereft of learning and strength.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 5th Lord occupies the 2nd House the native will have the blessing of having many sons and wealth. He will be supporter of his family, honourable, be attached to his wife and be famous in the world.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 6th Lord is situated in the 2nd House, the native will be adventurous, famous in his family, happy in foreign lands, eloquent, and always interested in his own work.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: In case the 6th Lord has fallen in the 2nd House, the native will be adventurous, illustrious in his family and he will live in alien countries or foreign lands, be happy, be a good speaker and be always interested in his own work.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 7th Lord is placed in the 2nd House the native will have many wives, will gain wealth through his wife and will be of procastinating nature.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 8th Lord is placed in the 2nd House, the native will be devoid of physical vigour will possess little weallth and will not regain lost wealth.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 9th Lord be situated in the 2nd House, the native will be learned, popular, wealthy, lustful, and be blessed with happiness through sons and wife.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 10th Lord occupies the 2nd House, the native will be wealthy, virtuous, honoured by the King (or the Government), charitable and endowed with paternal and other bliss.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 11th Lord be placed in the 2nd House, the native will be endowed with all kinds of wealth and all kinds of accomplishments, be charitable, religious and always happy.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 2
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 12th Lord be situated in the 2nd House, the native will always spend money on auspicious deeds, be religious, will speak sweetly and be blessed with virtues and happiness.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 4th Lord is situated in the 9th House, the native will be loved by one and all, be a devotee of God, Virtuous, honourable and blessed with every kind of happiness.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: A Lord of Kendra (angle) being placed in the principal trikona (trine) will certainly confer auspicious effects on the native. The 9th House is studied to know the natives aptitude towards God's devotion. Therefore the native's mind tends to lean towards the devotion of God. He is also a devoted disciple. In the Cancer Ascendant the 4th Lord being, situated in the 9th House, will be in his sign of exaltation. Therefore, the native in this Ascendant will be very popular, endowed with conveyances, all kinds of comforts and beautiful house. He will have his residental house near temple of some god (this effect will be had in all Ascendants). The native will get excellent effects in the Leo Ascendant.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Should the 5th Lord be placed in the 9th House the native will be prince or equal to prince, be an illustrious author and be illustrious in his family.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: If the 6th Lord is situated in the 9th House, the native will trade in wood and stones and will confront fluctuations in trade.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: Whenever the 6th and 9th are related in any way with each other, rise and fall in fortune are frequent in the native's destiny as the 6th House is the House of calamities and the 9th that of the rise of fortune.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9
BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.text: It the 7th Lord is situated in the 9th House, the native will have union with many women, be well disposed to his own wife, and will initiate a number of deeds.

BPHS_Sharma_Vol1_deep.subject: House 9

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 10th and 3rd houses are in conjunction or aspect each other, the individual will lose fortune during the Dasa of the 10th lord but will experience fortunate results during the Dasa of the 3rd lord.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: House 10
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Ownership of the 3rd house is detrimental for any planet. A natural benefic owning the 10th becomes a temporary malefic, while a natural malefic owning the 10th becomes a temporary benefic. When the 3rd and 10th lords are in conjunction, the 3rd lord acquires the capacity to grant fortunate outcomes.
