Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While dealing with Taurus Ascendant (Vrishabha Lagna), the author states that Saturn is not a yoga-producing planet (yogakaraka) for Taurus, despite the fact that it owns the 9th and 10th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhana yogas (combinations for wealth).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Nirdhana yogas (combinations for poverty).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vahana bhagya yoga (combinations for possessing vehicles and general fortune).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, which fall under the general term of Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, generally termed Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga), are treated in the Eighth Chapter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Ninth Chapter consists of 29 stanzas and discusses Raja yoga and Punya yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Stanza 26 of the Eleventh Chapter indicates that if Mercury is positioned in the 3rd house, the person becomes timid during the Rahu Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Twelfth Chapter discusses "Ordinary Combinations" (Grahasamanya yoga), providing combinations that either strengthen or weaken various houses (bhavas).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Thirteenth Chapter treats Malika yoga, which are combinations formed by planets arranged like a garland or wreath starting from the Ascendant (Lagna) or other houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Raja Yoga will undoubtedly result by the combination of the lords of the 4th and 5th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna the mere combination of the lords of the 9th and 10th, viz., Jupiter and Saturn does not result in Rajayoga: This is certain.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The mere yoga (combination) of Jupiter and Saturn will not produce good (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For Mesha lagna though Saturn is lord of the 10th he stands blemished because he is also the 11th lord. The evil is strong enough to vitiate Jupiter the 9th lord when he happens to be associated with the 11th lord. Hence the association of Saturn with Jupiter will not confer any yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha, if the lord of the 2nd is in the 12th, he becomes good. For those born in other lagnas the 2nd lord does not become good if he is placed in the 12th.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) no doubt becomes a Maraka if he is in conjunction with Venus, but still he will be capable of causing Yoga also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) will certainly become a Yoga Karaka (conferer of fame) if he occupies the 2nd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) does not produce any Yoga if he occupies the 3rd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kuja (Mars) will surely become a Yogaharaka for one who takes his birth in Mesha lagna, if he is in the 4th house combined with Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) in the 5th house surely causes yoga in the course of his own dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a death-inflicting planet (Maraka) if it is in conjunction with Venus, though this does not prevent it from also bestowing Yoga (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a giver of Yoga if it is placed in the 2nd house along with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The yoga (Mars, Jupiter, and Venus combination) is cancelled if it takes place in the 3rd house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Mars is in the 4th house (Cancer) with Jupiter, Mars becomes fully capable of producing Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter is in Cancer (the sign of its exaltation), the debilitation (Neecha) effect of Mars (the Ascendant Lord) is cancelled, resulting in a distinct Neechabhanga Raja Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the 12th stanza, Mars bestows fame during its Dasa if it is positioned in the 5th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born with Aries Ascendant, Jupiter in the 11th house cannot produce any Yoga during its Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For an individual born with Aries Ascendant, Mars placed in the 8th house does not generate any Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars (in the 8th house for Aries Ascendant) will nevertheless bestow some fame if it is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Aries ascendant, Mars in the 8th house does not produce an auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He [Mars] will, however, bestow some fame if he is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus [in the 8th house for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, if the Sun and Mars are in the 9th house, as are also Jupiter and Venus, and Saturn is in the 7th house, then Mars produces a special auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, Venus becomes capable of giving rise to an auspicious combination (yoga) provided he is in the ascendant with the Sun and is not aspected by Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus aspected by Jupiter will certainly not confer any auspicious combination (yoga) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But the Sun aspected by Jupiter becomes a producer of auspiciousness (yogakaraka) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries, a Raja yoga (royal combination) is formed if the Sun or the Moon is in the sign of Cancer.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter does not produce any auspicious combination (yoga) during his planetary period (dasa) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The placement of Venus and Mars in the 7th house is favorable for the self-acquisition of fortune and wealth [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Saturn does not become a producer of yoga (Yogakaraka) despite owning the 9th and 10th houses from the ascendant.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury also do not become capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) even if they occupy the ascendant [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Taurus ascendant, the Moon (Chandra) becomes capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) if he occupies the 4th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon (Chandra) also produces an auspicious combination (yoga) if aspected by Jupiter or Mercury [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Mars becomes a benefic in the 7th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus (Sukra) bestows Rajayoga during his major period if he is conjoined with Jupiter in the sign of Scorpio.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars' Dasa will be very fortunate and Jupiter's Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Jupiter and the Moon join together, Chandra Dasa will prove highly prosperous while Guru Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus and Jupiter in conjunction in Scorpio: Venus Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury: Mercury Dasa is highly benefic, Sun Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon and Mars: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Mars Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Saturn: Saturn Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Mars: Mars Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Moon: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu will confer Rajayoga and much fame in his Dasa if he joins a quadrant or a trine

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury and Venus join together or are in mutual aspect the native becomes very wealthy famous and fortunate

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when occupying a Kendra (quadrant) or Thrikona (trine) is supposed to give rise to Rajayoga in his Dasa

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus are in mutual conjunction or aspect, the native becomes fortunate and wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Rahu, the Sun, and Saturn are in the third house, Rahu gives rise to courage and fortune in his Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The learned in astrology say that all such bhavas (houses) whose lords are in conjunction with the respective karakas (significators) become strong.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lords of the 5th and 9th houses give good results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: However, in spite of owning the 8th house, Jupiter will confer fame and wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus in the 6th house will certainly give rise to fame and affluence.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus will give the same results (fame and affluence) in the 8th house also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers say that fame and affluence are conferred if Rahu is in the 10th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malefic planets produce Rajayoga by owning or occupying Kendras (quadrants).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus becomes beneficial in the 12th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Saturn is in the 10th house, he does not destroy the house's indications; instead, he gives fame, reputation, leadership, etc., but also causes the subject to have a sudden fall.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Saturn aspects the 3rd and 9th houses, they will gain strength.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He will become rich and a man of character if the waxing Moon is in Lagna,

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The native becomes fortunate if the Moon and Mars are either in Lagna or in the 8th house

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But Mars when he is with the Moon in the 8th, loses his evil nature so that the general fortune of the native is promoted.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th join together or aspect each other they produce good results

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For persons born in any Lagna, the presence of the lord of the 9th in the 8th does not give rise to any yoga-but only ordinary results will be produced

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th houses combine together or aspect each other, it is an important combination applicable in a large majority of cases.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Fortunes will be ordinary if the 9th lord is placed in the 8th house, provided the 9th house itself is also weak.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all nine planets occupy the five houses starting from the Lagna, Panchagraha Malika Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malika Yoga is defined as the placement of the seven planets in seven consecutive houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the planets are disposed consecutively starting from the 2nd house, it is called Dhana Malika Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When the seven planets occupy seven signs beginning from any specific sign, a semicircle is formed, and the term Malika (garland) is justified.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all planets occupy any five signs, Pasa Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Panchagraha malika yoga is caused when all eight planets are placed in the first five signs from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy six houses from the Ascendant, Shashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy seven houses from the Ascendant, Sapthagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy eight houses from the Ascendant, Ashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy nine houses from the Ascendant, Navagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain astrologers maintain that the Graha malika yoga starts from the Sun's position.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While others state that Malika yoga begins from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A person born with Graha Malika Yoga involving planets in 6, 7, 8, or 9 houses from the Ascendant will be fortunate (Bhagya yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers state that a person born in Graha malika yoga where planets occupy 5 houses from the Ascendant will also be fortunate.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Pasa yoga occurs when all seven planets (excluding Rahu/Kethu) occupy any five signs. The native will be talkative, clever in acquiring virtue and wealth, and will be blessed with sons.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all seven planets are placed in any six signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is formed.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If planets are in any 6 signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is caused. This is also one of the Nabhasa yogas.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the author, Shashtagraha malika is caused if all the planets are in the six signs from the 1st house. Damini yoga also produces favorable results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sapthagraha Malika yoga is supposed to be caused if all the nine planets occupy the seven signs from Lagna.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all planets occupy any seven signs, Vallaki is caused. The man born in Vallaki will be skilled and likes music and dancing.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all the seven planets occupy the seven houses from Lagna, it is Lagnamalika.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lagnamalika occurs when all planets are in the seven houses from lagna. The result is: King, Commander, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhanamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 2nd house. Result: Very wealthy, dutiful, resolute, unsympathetic.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vikramamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 3rd house. Result: Ruler, rich, sickly, surrounded by brave men.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sukhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 4th house. Result: Charitable, liberal, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Putramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 5th house. Result: Highly religious and famous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Satrumalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 6th house. Result: Greedy, somewhat poor.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kalatramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 7th house. Result: Coveted by women and influential.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Randhramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 8th house. Result: Poor and henpecked.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 9th house. Result: Religious, well to do, mighty and good.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Karmamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 10th house. Result: Respected, virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Labhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 11th house. Result: Skilful and lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vyayamalika (Vrayamalika) occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 12th house. Result: Honoured, liberal and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 10 Karmamalika from the 10th house: Respected and virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 11 Labhamalika from the 11th house: Skilful and the lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 12 Vrayamalika from the 12th house: Honoured, liberal, and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: There is a controversial point regarding whether these yogas should be reckoned from Bhavas (houses) or Rasis (signs). According to Varahamihira, terms like Rasi, Kshetra, Graha, Riksha, Bha, and Bhavana are synonymous. However, in common usage, Rasi means sign and Bhavana means house. The author specifically uses the word Rasi, suggesting Malika yoga is reckoned by signs. Sankhya yogas use signs, while Akriti yogas use houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: In the 9th and 10th places from the Sun, and in the 2nd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 11th, and 12th places from the Sun, malefics and benefics produce favorable and adverse results respectively.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Libra is a friendly sign and also the sign of exaltation for Saturn.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when exalted grants political power and fame during his Dasa period.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagya Yoga refers to a Fortunate combination.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyavahana Yoga refers to combinations that bring paraphernalia and vehicles.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Chandra Mangala Yoga is the conjunction or mutual aspect of Moon and Mars.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A Yoga mentioned in Brihat Jathka.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Moon-Mars conjunction or mutual aspect.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combination for wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Conjunction between 9th and 10th lord.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mutual disposition of the Moon and Jupiter in quadrants

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter Rahu conjunction.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Conjunction of Jupiter and Mars.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A kind of Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A combination formed by the position of planets in the ascendant

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for Royalty

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A combination paliating the debilitation.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combination for poverty.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Exchange of houses or signs.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain combinations technically known as 'numerical yogas'.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Auspicious exchange of places.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Sun benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Planet giving rise to a special combination

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for wealth

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for poverty

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for royal status or great success

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Garland of planets combinations

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While dealing with Taurus Ascendant (Vrishabha Lagna), the author states that Saturn is not a yoga-producing planet (yogakaraka) for Taurus, despite the fact that it owns the 9th and 10th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhana yogas (combinations for wealth).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Nirdhana yogas (combinations for poverty).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vahana bhagya yoga (combinations for possessing vehicles and general fortune).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, which fall under the general term of Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, generally termed Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga), are treated in the Eighth Chapter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Ninth Chapter consists of 29 stanzas and discusses Raja yoga and Punya yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Stanza 26 of the Eleventh Chapter indicates that if Mercury is positioned in the 3rd house, the person becomes timid during the Rahu Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Twelfth Chapter discusses "Ordinary Combinations" (Grahasamanya yoga), providing combinations that either strengthen or weaken various houses (bhavas).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Thirteenth Chapter treats Malika yoga, which are combinations formed by planets arranged like a garland or wreath starting from the Ascendant (Lagna) or other houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Raja Yoga will undoubtedly result by the combination of the lords of the 4th and 5th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna the mere combination of the lords of the 9th and 10th, viz., Jupiter and Saturn does not result in Rajayoga: This is certain.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The mere yoga (combination) of Jupiter and Saturn will not produce good (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For Mesha lagna though Saturn is lord of the 10th he stands blemished because he is also the 11th lord. The evil is strong enough to vitiate Jupiter the 9th lord when he happens to be associated with the 11th lord. Hence the association of Saturn with Jupiter will not confer any yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha, if the lord of the 2nd is in the 12th, he becomes good. For those born in other lagnas the 2nd lord does not become good if he is placed in the 12th.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) no doubt becomes a Maraka if he is in conjunction with Venus, but still he will be capable of causing Yoga also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) will certainly become a Yoga Karaka (conferer of fame) if he occupies the 2nd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) does not produce any Yoga if he occupies the 3rd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kuja (Mars) will surely become a Yogaharaka for one who takes his birth in Mesha lagna, if he is in the 4th house combined with Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) in the 5th house surely causes yoga in the course of his own dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a death-inflicting planet (Maraka) if it is in conjunction with Venus, though this does not prevent it from also bestowing Yoga (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a giver of Yoga if it is placed in the 2nd house along with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The yoga (Mars, Jupiter, and Venus combination) is cancelled if it takes place in the 3rd house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Mars is in the 4th house (Cancer) with Jupiter, Mars becomes fully capable of producing Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter is in Cancer (the sign of its exaltation), the debilitation (Neecha) effect of Mars (the Ascendant Lord) is cancelled, resulting in a distinct Neechabhanga Raja Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the 12th stanza, Mars bestows fame during its Dasa if it is positioned in the 5th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born with Aries Ascendant, Jupiter in the 11th house cannot produce any Yoga during its Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For an individual born with Aries Ascendant, Mars placed in the 8th house does not generate any Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars (in the 8th house for Aries Ascendant) will nevertheless bestow some fame if it is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Aries ascendant, Mars in the 8th house does not produce an auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He [Mars] will, however, bestow some fame if he is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus [in the 8th house for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, if the Sun and Mars are in the 9th house, as are also Jupiter and Venus, and Saturn is in the 7th house, then Mars produces a special auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, Venus becomes capable of giving rise to an auspicious combination (yoga) provided he is in the ascendant with the Sun and is not aspected by Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus aspected by Jupiter will certainly not confer any auspicious combination (yoga) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But the Sun aspected by Jupiter becomes a producer of auspiciousness (yogakaraka) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries, a Raja yoga (royal combination) is formed if the Sun or the Moon is in the sign of Cancer.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter does not produce any auspicious combination (yoga) during his planetary period (dasa) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The placement of Venus and Mars in the 7th house is favorable for the self-acquisition of fortune and wealth [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Saturn does not become a producer of yoga (Yogakaraka) despite owning the 9th and 10th houses from the ascendant.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury also do not become capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) even if they occupy the ascendant [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Taurus ascendant, the Moon (Chandra) becomes capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) if he occupies the 4th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon (Chandra) also produces an auspicious combination (yoga) if aspected by Jupiter or Mercury [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Mars becomes a benefic in the 7th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus (Sukra) bestows Rajayoga during his major period if he is conjoined with Jupiter in the sign of Scorpio.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars' Dasa will be very fortunate and Jupiter's Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Jupiter and the Moon join together, Chandra Dasa will prove highly prosperous while Guru Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus and Jupiter in conjunction in Scorpio: Venus Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury: Mercury Dasa is highly benefic, Sun Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon and Mars: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Mars Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Saturn: Saturn Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Mars: Mars Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Moon: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu will confer Rajayoga and much fame in his Dasa if he joins a quadrant or a trine

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury and Venus join together or are in mutual aspect the native becomes very wealthy famous and fortunate

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when occupying a Kendra (quadrant) or Thrikona (trine) is supposed to give rise to Rajayoga in his Dasa

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus are in mutual conjunction or aspect, the native becomes fortunate and wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Rahu, the Sun, and Saturn are in the third house, Rahu gives rise to courage and fortune in his Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The learned in astrology say that all such bhavas (houses) whose lords are in conjunction with the respective karakas (significators) become strong.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lords of the 5th and 9th houses give good results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: However, in spite of owning the 8th house, Jupiter will confer fame and wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus in the 6th house will certainly give rise to fame and affluence.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus will give the same results (fame and affluence) in the 8th house also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers say that fame and affluence are conferred if Rahu is in the 10th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malefic planets produce Rajayoga by owning or occupying Kendras (quadrants).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus becomes beneficial in the 12th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Saturn is in the 10th house, he does not destroy the house's indications; instead, he gives fame, reputation, leadership, etc., but also causes the subject to have a sudden fall.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Saturn aspects the 3rd and 9th houses, they will gain strength.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He will become rich and a man of character if the waxing Moon is in Lagna,

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The native becomes fortunate if the Moon and Mars are either in Lagna or in the 8th house

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But Mars when he is with the Moon in the 8th, loses his evil nature so that the general fortune of the native is promoted.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th join together or aspect each other they produce good results

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For persons born in any Lagna, the presence of the lord of the 9th in the 8th does not give rise to any yoga-but only ordinary results will be produced

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th houses combine together or aspect each other, it is an important combination applicable in a large majority of cases.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Fortunes will be ordinary if the 9th lord is placed in the 8th house, provided the 9th house itself is also weak.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all nine planets occupy the five houses starting from the Lagna, Panchagraha Malika Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malika Yoga is defined as the placement of the seven planets in seven consecutive houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the planets are disposed consecutively starting from the 2nd house, it is called Dhana Malika Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When the seven planets occupy seven signs beginning from any specific sign, a semicircle is formed, and the term Malika (garland) is justified.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all planets occupy any five signs, Pasa Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Panchagraha malika yoga is caused when all eight planets are placed in the first five signs from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy six houses from the Ascendant, Shashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy seven houses from the Ascendant, Sapthagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy eight houses from the Ascendant, Ashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy nine houses from the Ascendant, Navagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain astrologers maintain that the Graha malika yoga starts from the Sun's position.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While others state that Malika yoga begins from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A person born with Graha Malika Yoga involving planets in 6, 7, 8, or 9 houses from the Ascendant will be fortunate (Bhagya yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers state that a person born in Graha malika yoga where planets occupy 5 houses from the Ascendant will also be fortunate.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Pasa yoga occurs when all seven planets (excluding Rahu/Kethu) occupy any five signs. The native will be talkative, clever in acquiring virtue and wealth, and will be blessed with sons.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all seven planets are placed in any six signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is formed.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If planets are in any 6 signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is caused. This is also one of the Nabhasa yogas.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the author, Shashtagraha malika is caused if all the planets are in the six signs from the 1st house. Damini yoga also produces favorable results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sapthagraha Malika yoga is supposed to be caused if all the nine planets occupy the seven signs from Lagna.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all planets occupy any seven signs, Vallaki is caused. The man born in Vallaki will be skilled and likes music and dancing.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all the seven planets occupy the seven houses from Lagna, it is Lagnamalika.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lagnamalika occurs when all planets are in the seven houses from lagna. The result is: King, Commander, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhanamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 2nd house. Result: Very wealthy, dutiful, resolute, unsympathetic.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vikramamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 3rd house. Result: Ruler, rich, sickly, surrounded by brave men.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Apakartari Yoga (Mars benefic-shielded)

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Labhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 11th house. Result: Skilful and lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: There is a controversial point regarding whether these yogas should be reckoned from Bhavas (houses) or Rasis (signs). According to Varahamihira, terms like Rasi, Kshetra, Graha, Riksha, Bha, and Bhavana are synonymous. However, in common usage, Rasi means sign and Bhavana means house. The author specifically uses the word Rasi, suggesting Malika yoga is reckoned by signs. Sankhya yogas use signs, while Akriti yogas use houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: In the 9th and 10th places from the Sun, and in the 2nd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 11th, and 12th places from the Sun, malefics and benefics produce favorable and adverse results respectively.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Ninth Chapter consists of 29 stanzas and discusses Raja yoga and Punya yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Stanza 26 of the Eleventh Chapter indicates that if Mercury is positioned in the 3rd house, the person becomes timid during the Rahu Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Twelfth Chapter discusses "Ordinary Combinations" (Grahasamanya yoga), providing combinations that either strengthen or weaken various houses (bhavas).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Thirteenth Chapter treats Malika yoga, which are combinations formed by planets arranged like a garland or wreath starting from the Ascendant (Lagna) or other houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Raja Yoga will undoubtedly result by the combination of the lords of the 4th and 5th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna the mere combination of the lords of the 9th and 10th, viz., Jupiter and Saturn does not result in Rajayoga: This is certain.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The mere yoga (combination) of Jupiter and Saturn will not produce good (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For Mesha lagna though Saturn is lord of the 10th he stands blemished because he is also the 11th lord. The evil is strong enough to vitiate Jupiter the 9th lord when he happens to be associated with the 11th lord. Hence the association of Saturn with Jupiter will not confer any yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha, if the lord of the 2nd is in the 12th, he becomes good. For those born in other lagnas the 2nd lord does not become good if he is placed in the 12th.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) no doubt becomes a Maraka if he is in conjunction with Venus, but still he will be capable of causing Yoga also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) will certainly become a Yoga Karaka (conferer of fame) if he occupies the 2nd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) does not produce any Yoga if he occupies the 3rd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kuja (Mars) will surely become a Yogaharaka for one who takes his birth in Mesha lagna, if he is in the 4th house combined with Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) in the 5th house surely causes yoga in the course of his own dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a death-inflicting planet (Maraka) if it is in conjunction with Venus, though this does not prevent it from also bestowing Yoga (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a giver of Yoga if it is placed in the 2nd house along with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The yoga (Mars, Jupiter, and Venus combination) is cancelled if it takes place in the 3rd house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Mars is in the 4th house (Cancer) with Jupiter, Mars becomes fully capable of producing Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter is in Cancer (the sign of its exaltation), the debilitation (Neecha) effect of Mars (the Ascendant Lord) is cancelled, resulting in a distinct Neechabhanga Raja Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the 12th stanza, Mars bestows fame during its Dasa if it is positioned in the 5th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born with Aries Ascendant, Jupiter in the 11th house cannot produce any Yoga during its Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For an individual born with Aries Ascendant, Mars placed in the 8th house does not generate any Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars (in the 8th house for Aries Ascendant) will nevertheless bestow some fame if it is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Aries ascendant, Mars in the 8th house does not produce an auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He [Mars] will, however, bestow some fame if he is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus [in the 8th house for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, if the Sun and Mars are in the 9th house, as are also Jupiter and Venus, and Saturn is in the 7th house, then Mars produces a special auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, Venus becomes capable of giving rise to an auspicious combination (yoga) provided he is in the ascendant with the Sun and is not aspected by Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus aspected by Jupiter will certainly not confer any auspicious combination (yoga) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But the Sun aspected by Jupiter becomes a producer of auspiciousness (yogakaraka) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries, a Raja yoga (royal combination) is formed if the Sun or the Moon is in the sign of Cancer.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter does not produce any auspicious combination (yoga) during his planetary period (dasa) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The placement of Venus and Mars in the 7th house is favorable for the self-acquisition of fortune and wealth [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Saturn does not become a producer of yoga (Yogakaraka) despite owning the 9th and 10th houses from the ascendant.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury also do not become capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) even if they occupy the ascendant [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Taurus ascendant, the Moon (Chandra) becomes capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) if he occupies the 4th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon (Chandra) also produces an auspicious combination (yoga) if aspected by Jupiter or Mercury [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Mars becomes a benefic in the 7th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus (Sukra) bestows Rajayoga during his major period if he is conjoined with Jupiter in the sign of Scorpio.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars' Dasa will be very fortunate and Jupiter's Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Jupiter and the Moon join together, Chandra Dasa will prove highly prosperous while Guru Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus and Jupiter in conjunction in Scorpio: Venus Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury: Mercury Dasa is highly benefic, Sun Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon and Mars: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Mars Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Saturn: Saturn Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Mars: Mars Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Moon: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu will confer Rajayoga and much fame in his Dasa if he joins a quadrant or a trine

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury and Venus join together or are in mutual aspect the native becomes very wealthy famous and fortunate

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when occupying a Kendra (quadrant) or Thrikona (trine) is supposed to give rise to Rajayoga in his Dasa

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus are in mutual conjunction or aspect, the native becomes fortunate and wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Rahu, the Sun, and Saturn are in the third house, Rahu gives rise to courage and fortune in his Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The learned in astrology say that all such bhavas (houses) whose lords are in conjunction with the respective karakas (significators) become strong.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lords of the 5th and 9th houses give good results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: However, in spite of owning the 8th house, Jupiter will confer fame and wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus in the 6th house will certainly give rise to fame and affluence.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus will give the same results (fame and affluence) in the 8th house also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers say that fame and affluence are conferred if Rahu is in the 10th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malefic planets produce Rajayoga by owning or occupying Kendras (quadrants).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus becomes beneficial in the 12th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Saturn is in the 10th house, he does not destroy the house's indications; instead, he gives fame, reputation, leadership, etc., but also causes the subject to have a sudden fall.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Saturn aspects the 3rd and 9th houses, they will gain strength.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He will become rich and a man of character if the waxing Moon is in Lagna,

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The native becomes fortunate if the Moon and Mars are either in Lagna or in the 8th house

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But Mars when he is with the Moon in the 8th, loses his evil nature so that the general fortune of the native is promoted.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th join together or aspect each other they produce good results

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For persons born in any Lagna, the presence of the lord of the 9th in the 8th does not give rise to any yoga-but only ordinary results will be produced

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th houses combine together or aspect each other, it is an important combination applicable in a large majority of cases.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Fortunes will be ordinary if the 9th lord is placed in the 8th house, provided the 9th house itself is also weak.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all nine planets occupy the five houses starting from the Lagna, Panchagraha Malika Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malika Yoga is defined as the placement of the seven planets in seven consecutive houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the planets are disposed consecutively starting from the 2nd house, it is called Dhana Malika Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When the seven planets occupy seven signs beginning from any specific sign, a semicircle is formed, and the term Malika (garland) is justified.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all planets occupy any five signs, Pasa Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Panchagraha malika yoga is caused when all eight planets are placed in the first five signs from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy six houses from the Ascendant, Shashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy seven houses from the Ascendant, Sapthagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy eight houses from the Ascendant, Ashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy nine houses from the Ascendant, Navagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain astrologers maintain that the Graha malika yoga starts from the Sun's position.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While others state that Malika yoga begins from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A person born with Graha Malika Yoga involving planets in 6, 7, 8, or 9 houses from the Ascendant will be fortunate (Bhagya yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers state that a person born in Graha malika yoga where planets occupy 5 houses from the Ascendant will also be fortunate.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Pasa yoga occurs when all seven planets (excluding Rahu/Kethu) occupy any five signs. The native will be talkative, clever in acquiring virtue and wealth, and will be blessed with sons.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all seven planets are placed in any six signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is formed.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If planets are in any 6 signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is caused. This is also one of the Nabhasa yogas.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the author, Shashtagraha malika is caused if all the planets are in the six signs from the 1st house. Damini yoga also produces favorable results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sapthagraha Malika yoga is supposed to be caused if all the nine planets occupy the seven signs from Lagna.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all planets occupy any seven signs, Vallaki is caused. The man born in Vallaki will be skilled and likes music and dancing.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all the seven planets occupy the seven houses from Lagna, it is Lagnamalika.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lagnamalika occurs when all planets are in the seven houses from lagna. The result is: King, Commander, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhanamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 2nd house. Result: Very wealthy, dutiful, resolute, unsympathetic.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vikramamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 3rd house. Result: Ruler, rich, sickly, surrounded by brave men.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sukhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 4th house. Result: Charitable, liberal, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Putramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 5th house. Result: Highly religious and famous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Satrumalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 6th house. Result: Greedy, somewhat poor.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kalatramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 7th house. Result: Coveted by women and influential.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Randhramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 8th house. Result: Poor and henpecked.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 9th house. Result: Religious, well to do, mighty and good.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Karmamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 10th house. Result: Respected, virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Labhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 11th house. Result: Skilful and lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vyayamalika (Vrayamalika) occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 12th house. Result: Honoured, liberal and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 10 Karmamalika from the 10th house: Respected and virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 11 Labhamalika from the 11th house: Skilful and the lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 12 Vrayamalika from the 12th house: Honoured, liberal, and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: There is a controversial point regarding whether these yogas should be reckoned from Bhavas (houses) or Rasis (signs). According to Varahamihira, terms like Rasi, Kshetra, Graha, Riksha, Bha, and Bhavana are synonymous. However, in common usage, Rasi means sign and Bhavana means house. The author specifically uses the word Rasi, suggesting Malika yoga is reckoned by signs. Sankhya yogas use signs, while Akriti yogas use houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: In the 9th and 10th places from the Sun, and in the 2nd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 11th, and 12th places from the Sun, malefics and benefics produce favorable and adverse results respectively.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Libra is a friendly sign and also the sign of exaltation for Saturn.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when exalted grants political power and fame during his Dasa period.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagya Yoga refers to a Fortunate combination.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyavahana Yoga refers to combinations that bring paraphernalia and vehicles.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Chandra Mangala Yoga is the conjunction or mutual aspect of Moon and Mars.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A Yoga mentioned in Brihat Jathka.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Moon-Mars conjunction or mutual aspect.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combination for wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Conjunction between 9th and 10th lord.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mutual disposition of the Moon and Jupiter in quadrants

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter Rahu conjunction.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Conjunction of Jupiter and Mars.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A kind of Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A combination formed by the position of planets in the ascendant

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for Royalty

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A combination paliating the debilitation.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combination for poverty.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Exchange of houses or signs.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain combinations technically known as 'numerical yogas'.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Auspicious exchange of places.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Nisswayoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Planet giving rise to a special combination
