Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for wealth

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for poverty

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for royal status or great success

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Garland of planets combinations

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While dealing with Taurus Ascendant (Vrishabha Lagna), the author states that Saturn is not a yoga-producing planet (yogakaraka) for Taurus, despite the fact that it owns the 9th and 10th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhana yogas (combinations for wealth).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Nirdhana yogas (combinations for poverty).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vahana bhagya yoga (combinations for possessing vehicles and general fortune).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, which fall under the general term of Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, generally termed Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga), are treated in the Eighth Chapter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Ninth Chapter consists of 29 stanzas and discusses Raja yoga and Punya yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Stanza 26 of the Eleventh Chapter indicates that if Mercury is positioned in the 3rd house, the person becomes timid during the Rahu Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Twelfth Chapter discusses "Ordinary Combinations" (Grahasamanya yoga), providing combinations that either strengthen or weaken various houses (bhavas).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Thirteenth Chapter treats Malika yoga, which are combinations formed by planets arranged like a garland or wreath starting from the Ascendant (Lagna) or other houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Raja Yoga will undoubtedly result by the combination of the lords of the 4th and 5th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna the mere combination of the lords of the 9th and 10th, viz., Jupiter and Saturn does not result in Rajayoga: This is certain.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The mere yoga (combination) of Jupiter and Saturn will not produce good (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For Mesha lagna though Saturn is lord of the 10th he stands blemished because he is also the 11th lord. The evil is strong enough to vitiate Jupiter the 9th lord when he happens to be associated with the 11th lord. Hence the association of Saturn with Jupiter will not confer any yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha, if the lord of the 2nd is in the 12th, he becomes good. For those born in other lagnas the 2nd lord does not become good if he is placed in the 12th.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) no doubt becomes a Maraka if he is in conjunction with Venus, but still he will be capable of causing Yoga also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) will certainly become a Yoga Karaka (conferer of fame) if he occupies the 2nd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) does not produce any Yoga if he occupies the 3rd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kuja (Mars) will surely become a Yogaharaka for one who takes his birth in Mesha lagna, if he is in the 4th house combined with Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) in the 5th house surely causes yoga in the course of his own dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a death-inflicting planet (Maraka) if it is in conjunction with Venus, though this does not prevent it from also bestowing Yoga (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a giver of Yoga if it is placed in the 2nd house along with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The yoga (Mars, Jupiter, and Venus combination) is cancelled if it takes place in the 3rd house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Mars is in the 4th house (Cancer) with Jupiter, Mars becomes fully capable of producing Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter is in Cancer (the sign of its exaltation), the debilitation (Neecha) effect of Mars (the Ascendant Lord) is cancelled, resulting in a distinct Neechabhanga Raja Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the 12th stanza, Mars bestows fame during its Dasa if it is positioned in the 5th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born with Aries Ascendant, Jupiter in the 11th house cannot produce any Yoga during its Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For an individual born with Aries Ascendant, Mars placed in the 8th house does not generate any Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars (in the 8th house for Aries Ascendant) will nevertheless bestow some fame if it is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Aries ascendant, Mars in the 8th house does not produce an auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He [Mars] will, however, bestow some fame if he is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus [in the 8th house for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, if the Sun and Mars are in the 9th house, as are also Jupiter and Venus, and Saturn is in the 7th house, then Mars produces a special auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, Venus becomes capable of giving rise to an auspicious combination (yoga) provided he is in the ascendant with the Sun and is not aspected by Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus aspected by Jupiter will certainly not confer any auspicious combination (yoga) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But the Sun aspected by Jupiter becomes a producer of auspiciousness (yogakaraka) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries, a Raja yoga (royal combination) is formed if the Sun or the Moon is in the sign of Cancer.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter does not produce any auspicious combination (yoga) during his planetary period (dasa) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The placement of Venus and Mars in the 7th house is favorable for the self-acquisition of fortune and wealth [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Saturn does not become a producer of yoga (Yogakaraka) despite owning the 9th and 10th houses from the ascendant.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury also do not become capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) even if they occupy the ascendant [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Taurus ascendant, the Moon (Chandra) becomes capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) if he occupies the 4th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon (Chandra) also produces an auspicious combination (yoga) if aspected by Jupiter or Mercury [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Mars becomes a benefic in the 7th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus (Sukra) bestows Rajayoga during his major period if he is conjoined with Jupiter in the sign of Scorpio.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars' Dasa will be very fortunate and Jupiter's Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Jupiter and the Moon join together, Chandra Dasa will prove highly prosperous while Guru Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus and Jupiter in conjunction in Scorpio: Venus Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury: Mercury Dasa is highly benefic, Sun Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon and Mars: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Mars Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Saturn: Saturn Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Mars: Mars Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Moon: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu will confer Rajayoga and much fame in his Dasa if he joins a quadrant or a trine

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury and Venus join together or are in mutual aspect the native becomes very wealthy famous and fortunate

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when occupying a Kendra (quadrant) or Thrikona (trine) is supposed to give rise to Rajayoga in his Dasa

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus are in mutual conjunction or aspect, the native becomes fortunate and wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Rahu, the Sun, and Saturn are in the third house, Rahu gives rise to courage and fortune in his Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The learned in astrology say that all such bhavas (houses) whose lords are in conjunction with the respective karakas (significators) become strong.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lords of the 5th and 9th houses give good results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: However, in spite of owning the 8th house, Jupiter will confer fame and wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus in the 6th house will certainly give rise to fame and affluence.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus will give the same results (fame and affluence) in the 8th house also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers say that fame and affluence are conferred if Rahu is in the 10th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malefic planets produce Rajayoga by owning or occupying Kendras (quadrants).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus becomes beneficial in the 12th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Saturn is in the 10th house, he does not destroy the house's indications; instead, he gives fame, reputation, leadership, etc., but also causes the subject to have a sudden fall.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Saturn aspects the 3rd and 9th houses, they will gain strength.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He will become rich and a man of character if the waxing Moon is in Lagna,

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The native becomes fortunate if the Moon and Mars are either in Lagna or in the 8th house

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But Mars when he is with the Moon in the 8th, loses his evil nature so that the general fortune of the native is promoted.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th join together or aspect each other they produce good results

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For persons born in any Lagna, the presence of the lord of the 9th in the 8th does not give rise to any yoga-but only ordinary results will be produced

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th houses combine together or aspect each other, it is an important combination applicable in a large majority of cases.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Fortunes will be ordinary if the 9th lord is placed in the 8th house, provided the 9th house itself is also weak.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all nine planets occupy the five houses starting from the Lagna, Panchagraha Malika Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malika Yoga is defined as the placement of the seven planets in seven consecutive houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the planets are disposed consecutively starting from the 2nd house, it is called Dhana Malika Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When the seven planets occupy seven signs beginning from any specific sign, a semicircle is formed, and the term Malika (garland) is justified.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all planets occupy any five signs, Pasa Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Panchagraha malika yoga is caused when all eight planets are placed in the first five signs from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy six houses from the Ascendant, Shashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy seven houses from the Ascendant, Sapthagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy eight houses from the Ascendant, Ashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy nine houses from the Ascendant, Navagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain astrologers maintain that the Graha malika yoga starts from the Sun's position.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While others state that Malika yoga begins from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A person born with Graha Malika Yoga involving planets in 6, 7, 8, or 9 houses from the Ascendant will be fortunate (Bhagya yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers state that a person born in Graha malika yoga where planets occupy 5 houses from the Ascendant will also be fortunate.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Pasa yoga occurs when all seven planets (excluding Rahu/Kethu) occupy any five signs. The native will be talkative, clever in acquiring virtue and wealth, and will be blessed with sons.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all seven planets are placed in any six signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is formed.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If planets are in any 6 signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is caused. This is also one of the Nabhasa yogas.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the author, Shashtagraha malika is caused if all the planets are in the six signs from the 1st house. Damini yoga also produces favorable results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sapthagraha Malika yoga is supposed to be caused if all the nine planets occupy the seven signs from Lagna.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all planets occupy any seven signs, Vallaki is caused. The man born in Vallaki will be skilled and likes music and dancing.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all the seven planets occupy the seven houses from Lagna, it is Lagnamalika.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lagnamalika occurs when all planets are in the seven houses from lagna. The result is: King, Commander, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhanamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 2nd house. Result: Very wealthy, dutiful, resolute, unsympathetic.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vikramamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 3rd house. Result: Ruler, rich, sickly, surrounded by brave men.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sukhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 4th house. Result: Charitable, liberal, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Putramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 5th house. Result: Highly religious and famous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Satrumalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 6th house. Result: Greedy, somewhat poor.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kalatramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 7th house. Result: Coveted by women and influential.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Randhramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 8th house. Result: Poor and henpecked.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 9th house. Result: Religious, well to do, mighty and good.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Karmamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 10th house. Result: Respected, virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Labhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 11th house. Result: Skilful and lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vyayamalika (Vrayamalika) occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 12th house. Result: Honoured, liberal and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 10 Karmamalika from the 10th house: Respected and virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 11 Labhamalika from the 11th house: Skilful and the lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 12 Vrayamalika from the 12th house: Honoured, liberal, and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: There is a controversial point regarding whether these yogas should be reckoned from Bhavas (houses) or Rasis (signs). According to Varahamihira, terms like Rasi, Kshetra, Graha, Riksha, Bha, and Bhavana are synonymous. However, in common usage, Rasi means sign and Bhavana means house. The author specifically uses the word Rasi, suggesting Malika yoga is reckoned by signs. Sankhya yogas use signs, while Akriti yogas use houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: In the 9th and 10th places from the Sun, and in the 2nd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 11th, and 12th places from the Sun, malefics and benefics produce favorable and adverse results respectively.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Libra is a friendly sign and also the sign of exaltation for Saturn.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when exalted grants political power and fame during his Dasa period.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagya Yoga refers to a Fortunate combination.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyavahana Yoga refers to combinations that bring paraphernalia and vehicles.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Chandra Mangala Yoga is the conjunction or mutual aspect of Moon and Mars.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A Yoga mentioned in Brihat Jathka.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Moon-Mars conjunction or mutual aspect.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combination for wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Conjunction between 9th and 10th lord.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mutual disposition of the Moon and Jupiter in quadrants

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter Rahu conjunction.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Conjunction of Jupiter and Mars.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A kind of Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A combination formed by the position of planets in the ascendant

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for Royalty

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A combination paliating the debilitation.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combination for poverty.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Exchange of houses or signs.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain combinations technically known as 'numerical yogas'.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Auspicious exchange of places.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Dushkriti-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Planet giving rise to a special combination

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for wealth

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for poverty

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Combinations for royal status or great success

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Garland of planets combinations

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While dealing with Taurus Ascendant (Vrishabha Lagna), the author states that Saturn is not a yoga-producing planet (yogakaraka) for Taurus, despite the fact that it owns the 9th and 10th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhana yogas (combinations for wealth).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Nirdhana yogas (combinations for poverty).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vahana bhagya yoga (combinations for possessing vehicles and general fortune).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, which fall under the general term of Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The indications of the ninth house, generally termed Fortunate Combinations (Bhagyayoga), are treated in the Eighth Chapter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Ninth Chapter consists of 29 stanzas and discusses Raja yoga and Punya yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Stanza 26 of the Eleventh Chapter indicates that if Mercury is positioned in the 3rd house, the person becomes timid during the Rahu Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Twelfth Chapter discusses "Ordinary Combinations" (Grahasamanya yoga), providing combinations that either strengthen or weaken various houses (bhavas).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Thirteenth Chapter treats Malika yoga, which are combinations formed by planets arranged like a garland or wreath starting from the Ascendant (Lagna) or other houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Raja Yoga will undoubtedly result by the combination of the lords of the 4th and 5th houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna the mere combination of the lords of the 9th and 10th, viz., Jupiter and Saturn does not result in Rajayoga: This is certain.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The mere yoga (combination) of Jupiter and Saturn will not produce good (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For Mesha lagna though Saturn is lord of the 10th he stands blemished because he is also the 11th lord. The evil is strong enough to vitiate Jupiter the 9th lord when he happens to be associated with the 11th lord. Hence the association of Saturn with Jupiter will not confer any yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha, if the lord of the 2nd is in the 12th, he becomes good. For those born in other lagnas the 2nd lord does not become good if he is placed in the 12th.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) no doubt becomes a Maraka if he is in conjunction with Venus, but still he will be capable of causing Yoga also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna Kuja (Mars) will certainly become a Yoga Karaka (conferer of fame) if he occupies the 2nd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) does not produce any Yoga if he occupies the 3rd house with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kuja (Mars) will surely become a Yogaharaka for one who takes his birth in Mesha lagna, if he is in the 4th house combined with Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Mesha lagna, Kuja (Mars) in the 5th house surely causes yoga in the course of his own dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a death-inflicting planet (Maraka) if it is in conjunction with Venus, though this does not prevent it from also bestowing Yoga (auspicious results).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars becomes a giver of Yoga if it is placed in the 2nd house along with Jupiter and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The yoga (Mars, Jupiter, and Venus combination) is cancelled if it takes place in the 3rd house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Mars is in the 4th house (Cancer) with Jupiter, Mars becomes fully capable of producing Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter is in Cancer (the sign of its exaltation), the debilitation (Neecha) effect of Mars (the Ascendant Lord) is cancelled, resulting in a distinct Neechabhanga Raja Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the 12th stanza, Mars bestows fame during its Dasa if it is positioned in the 5th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born with Aries Ascendant, Jupiter in the 11th house cannot produce any Yoga during its Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For an individual born with Aries Ascendant, Mars placed in the 8th house does not generate any Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars (in the 8th house for Aries Ascendant) will nevertheless bestow some fame if it is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Aries ascendant, Mars in the 8th house does not produce an auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He [Mars] will, however, bestow some fame if he is in conjunction with the Sun and Venus [in the 8th house for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, if the Sun and Mars are in the 9th house, as are also Jupiter and Venus, and Saturn is in the 7th house, then Mars produces a special auspicious combination (yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries ascendant, Venus becomes capable of giving rise to an auspicious combination (yoga) provided he is in the ascendant with the Sun and is not aspected by Jupiter.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus aspected by Jupiter will certainly not confer any auspicious combination (yoga) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But the Sun aspected by Jupiter becomes a producer of auspiciousness (yogakaraka) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Aries, a Raja yoga (royal combination) is formed if the Sun or the Moon is in the sign of Cancer.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter does not produce any auspicious combination (yoga) during his planetary period (dasa) [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The placement of Venus and Mars in the 7th house is favorable for the self-acquisition of fortune and wealth [for Aries ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Saturn does not become a producer of yoga (Yogakaraka) despite owning the 9th and 10th houses from the ascendant.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury also do not become capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) even if they occupy the ascendant [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For one born in Taurus ascendant, the Moon (Chandra) becomes capable of producing an auspicious combination (yoga) if he occupies the 4th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon (Chandra) also produces an auspicious combination (yoga) if aspected by Jupiter or Mercury [for Taurus ascendant].

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For a person born in Taurus ascendant, Mars becomes a benefic in the 7th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus (Sukra) bestows Rajayoga during his major period if he is conjoined with Jupiter in the sign of Scorpio.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Mars' Dasa will be very fortunate and Jupiter's Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Jupiter and the Moon join together, Chandra Dasa will prove highly prosperous while Guru Dasa will be ordinary

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus and Jupiter in conjunction in Scorpio: Venus Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Sun and Mercury: Mercury Dasa is highly benefic, Sun Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The Moon and Mars: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Mars Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Saturn: Saturn Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Mars: Mars Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Jupiter and Moon: Moon Dasa is highly benefic, Jupiter Dasa is ordinary.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu will confer Rajayoga and much fame in his Dasa if he joins a quadrant or a trine

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury and Venus join together or are in mutual aspect the native becomes very wealthy famous and fortunate

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when occupying a Kendra (quadrant) or Thrikona (trine) is supposed to give rise to Rajayoga in his Dasa

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus are in mutual conjunction or aspect, the native becomes fortunate and wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Rahu, the Sun, and Saturn are in the third house, Rahu gives rise to courage and fortune in his Dasa.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The learned in astrology say that all such bhavas (houses) whose lords are in conjunction with the respective karakas (significators) become strong.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lords of the 5th and 9th houses give good results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: However, in spite of owning the 8th house, Jupiter will confer fame and wealth.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus in the 6th house will certainly give rise to fame and affluence.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus will give the same results (fame and affluence) in the 8th house also.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers say that fame and affluence are conferred if Rahu is in the 10th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malefic planets produce Rajayoga by owning or occupying Kendras (quadrants).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Venus becomes beneficial in the 12th house.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When Saturn is in the 10th house, he does not destroy the house's indications; instead, he gives fame, reputation, leadership, etc., but also causes the subject to have a sudden fall.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If Saturn aspects the 3rd and 9th houses, they will gain strength.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: He will become rich and a man of character if the waxing Moon is in Lagna,

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: The native becomes fortunate if the Moon and Mars are either in Lagna or in the 8th house

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: But Mars when he is with the Moon in the 8th, loses his evil nature so that the general fortune of the native is promoted.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th join together or aspect each other they produce good results

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: For persons born in any Lagna, the presence of the lord of the 9th in the 8th does not give rise to any yoga-but only ordinary results will be produced

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the lords of the 11th and 12th houses combine together or aspect each other, it is an important combination applicable in a large majority of cases.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Fortunes will be ordinary if the 9th lord is placed in the 8th house, provided the 9th house itself is also weak.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all nine planets occupy the five houses starting from the Lagna, Panchagraha Malika Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Malika Yoga is defined as the placement of the seven planets in seven consecutive houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If the planets are disposed consecutively starting from the 2nd house, it is called Dhana Malika Yoga.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When the seven planets occupy seven signs beginning from any specific sign, a semicircle is formed, and the term Malika (garland) is justified.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all planets occupy any five signs, Pasa Yoga is caused.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Panchagraha malika yoga is caused when all eight planets are placed in the first five signs from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy six houses from the Ascendant, Shashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy seven houses from the Ascendant, Sapthagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy eight houses from the Ascendant, Ashtagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all the planets occupy nine houses from the Ascendant, Navagraha malika yoga is produced.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Certain astrologers maintain that the Graha malika yoga starts from the Sun's position.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: While others state that Malika yoga begins from the Ascendant (Lagna).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: A person born with Graha Malika Yoga involving planets in 6, 7, 8, or 9 houses from the Ascendant will be fortunate (Bhagya yoga).

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Astrologers state that a person born in Graha malika yoga where planets occupy 5 houses from the Ascendant will also be fortunate.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Pasa yoga occurs when all seven planets (excluding Rahu/Kethu) occupy any five signs. The native will be talkative, clever in acquiring virtue and wealth, and will be blessed with sons.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all seven planets are placed in any six signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is formed.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If planets are in any 6 signs (as opposed to houses), Damini yoga is caused. This is also one of the Nabhasa yogas.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: According to the author, Shashtagraha malika is caused if all the planets are in the six signs from the 1st house. Damini yoga also produces favorable results.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sapthagraha Malika yoga is supposed to be caused if all the nine planets occupy the seven signs from Lagna.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: If all planets occupy any seven signs, Vallaki is caused. The man born in Vallaki will be skilled and likes music and dancing.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: When all the seven planets occupy the seven houses from Lagna, it is Lagnamalika.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Lagnamalika occurs when all planets are in the seven houses from lagna. The result is: King, Commander, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Dhanamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 2nd house. Result: Very wealthy, dutiful, resolute, unsympathetic.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vikramamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 3rd house. Result: Ruler, rich, sickly, surrounded by brave men.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Sukhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 4th house. Result: Charitable, liberal, wealthy.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Putramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 5th house. Result: Highly religious and famous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Satrumalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 6th house. Result: Greedy, somewhat poor.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Kalatramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 7th house. Result: Coveted by women and influential.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Randhramalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 8th house. Result: Poor and henpecked.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 9th house. Result: Religious, well to do, mighty and good.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Karmamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 10th house. Result: Respected, virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Labhamalika occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 11th house. Result: Skilful and lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Vyayamalika (Vrayamalika) occurs when all planets are in seven houses starting from the 12th house. Result: Honoured, liberal and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 10 Karmamalika from the 10th house: Respected and virtuous.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 11 Labhamalika from the 11th house: Skilful and the lord of lovely women.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: 12 Vrayamalika from the 12th house: Honoured, liberal, and respected.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: There is a controversial point regarding whether these yogas should be reckoned from Bhavas (houses) or Rasis (signs). According to Varahamihira, terms like Rasi, Kshetra, Graha, Riksha, Bha, and Bhavana are synonymous. However, in common usage, Rasi means sign and Bhavana means house. The author specifically uses the word Rasi, suggesting Malika yoga is reckoned by signs. Sankhya yogas use signs, while Akriti yogas use houses.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: In the 9th and 10th places from the Sun, and in the 2nd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 11th, and 12th places from the Sun, malefics and benefics produce favorable and adverse results respectively.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Rahu when exalted grants political power and fame during his Dasa period.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagya Yoga refers to a Fortunate combination.

Bhavartha_Ratnakara_Raman_deep.text: Bhagyavahana Yoga refers to combinations that bring paraphernalia and vehicles.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: House 8

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: House 8
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: In a birth chart, the planet that is situated in a house aspects the third and tenth houses from itself with a one-quarter aspect, the fifth and ninth houses with a two-quarter aspect, the fourth and eighth houses with a three-quarter aspect, and the seventh house with a full aspect. This rule applies equally to all planets.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: House 8
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Results of Mars situated in the second house of Leo ascendant chart. Leo Ascendant : Second House : Mars. In the second house, due to the influence of Mars situated in the friendly sign of [corrupted word], the native gets happiness of wealth and family. But there is some deficiency in the [corrupted word] of mother, land and house. Due to the fourth friendly aspect on the fifth house, success is achieved in the areas of knowledge, intellect and children. Due to the seventh friendly aspect on the eighth house, longevity and archaeology/ancient knowledge increase. Due to the eighth aspect on the ninth house of its own sign, luck and religion also increase.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Second House: Due to the influence of Sun, the lord of the 4th house, situated in the second house in the friendly sign of Mercury (Gemini), the native gets happiness from wealth and family, but there is some deficiency in the happiness of the mother. Also, despite having happiness from land and house, its full use is not possible. Due to Sun aspecting the eighth house with its seventh friendly aspect, the native has an increase in longevity and also benefits from ancient knowledge/archeology. Thus, the native's daily income remains good.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Third House: Due to the influence of Budha situated in the sign of Moon in the third house, the native's valor increases, and they also receive happiness from siblings. They earn wealth through their valor. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the ninth house, the native's interest in spiritual knowledge remains high, and fortune also increases. Such a person is valorous, intelligent, learned, brave, wealthy, righteous, and of good nature.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Fourth House: Due to the influence of Sun, the lord of the 4th house, situated in its own sign (Leo) in the fourth house, the native gets sufficient happiness from mother, land, house, and family. The native lives with great pomp and show, but despite showing off a lot, there remains some unrest in his mind. Due to Sun aspecting the tenth house with its seventh inimical aspect, there is dissatisfaction in the areas of father, government, and business, and one has to work hard to achieve prestige and success.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Fifth House: Due to the influence of Sun, the lord of the 4th house, situated in the fifth house in the friendly sign of Mercury (Virgo), the native gets happiness from mother, land, house, and domestic life. The matters of education and children also remain excellent. Such a native is strong, serious, and intelligent. Due to Sun aspecting the eleventh house with its seventh friendly aspect, the native's sources of income also remain good, and he gets opportunities for special gains from time to time.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 6th house: Sun in the 6th house, in the sign of enemy Venus, in a debilitated state, causes the native to face difficulties from enemies, but soon gains control over them; however, there is a decrease in the happiness of father, land, and other aspects.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 7th house: Sun in the 7th house, in the sign of friendly Mars, causes the native to achieve success in business and married life, and also gains happiness from land, house, and mother.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 8th house: Sun in the 8th house, in the sign of Jupiter, causes the native to live far from their birthplace, and there are obstacles in the happiness of mother, land, house, and family; however, there is special benefit from ancient knowledge and wealth.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 9th house: Sun in the 9th house, in the sign of Saturn, causes an increase in the native's happiness and good fortune; however, there is some decrease in the happiness of father, land, and others.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 10th house: Sun in the 10th house, in the sign of enemy Saturn, causes the native to achieve incomplete success in government, father, and business fields, with difficulties.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 11th house: Sun in the 11th house, in the sign of friendly Jupiter, causes an excessive increase in the native's income, and they also gain sufficient happiness from mother, wife, land, and house.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 12th house: Sun in the 12th house, in the sign of friendly Mars, causes the native to have excellent relations with foreign places, but there is excessive expenditure, and there is some decrease in the happiness of mother, family, and land-house.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 1st house: Moon in the 1st house, in the sign of neutral friend Venus, in an exalted state, causes the native's mental state to be very good.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus ascendant: 2nd house: Moon in the 2nd house, in the sign of friendly Jupiter, causes the native to earn wealth through their own efforts, and they also have family happiness; however, there is some decrease in the happiness and courage of brothers and sisters.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: 6th House: Mars situated in the 6th house in an enemy sign. Due to the influence of Mars, the lord of the 7th house, the native remains powerful over their enemies, but experiences losses in matters of spouse and business. Due to its exalted 4th aspect on the 9th house, it increases wealth and fortune. Due to its 7th aspect on the 12th house, expenses are usually high, but there is gain from foreign relations. Due to its enemy 8th aspect on the 1st house, the native's body remains weak and becomes a victim of blood-related and seminal disorders.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant chart: Results of Mars situated in the 10th House. Taurus Ascendant: 10th House: Mars situated in the 10th house in a friendly Saturn sign. Due to the influence of Mars, the native experiences troubles related to father and government. There is gain in business through foreign connections. Even if there is influence on something, mental discord persists. Due to its enemy 4th aspect on the 1st house, there is physical weakness and blood-related disorders. Due to its friendly 7th aspect on the 4th house, there is a reduction in the happiness of mother, land, buildings, and domestic comforts. Due to its friendly 8th aspect on the 5th house, there is disagreement with children. The gain from friends is also less, but wealth continues to increase.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: First House: Happiness. Due to the influence of Budha, the lord of the 2nd and 5th houses, situated in a friendly sign of Venus in the first house, the native is beautiful, renowned, famous, and possesses strength in family and wealth. Education, intelligence, and children also remain good. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the seventh house, success and support are also obtained in matters of spouse and business.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Sixth House: Due to the influence of Budha situated in a friendly sign of Venus in the sixth house, the native experiences unrest due to enemies, but also achieves success over them through their intelligence. There are also indications of differences and troubles with children and friends. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the twelfth house, there is a risk of wealth being stolen, but respect and wealth are gained through connections with foreign places.

Even if there is influence on something, mental discord persists. Due to its enemy 4th aspect on the 1st house, there is physical weakness and blood-related disorders. Due to its friendly 7th aspect on the 4th house, there is a reduction in the happiness of mother, land, buildings, and domestic comforts. Due to its friendly 8th aspect on the 5th house, there is disagreement with children. The gain from friends is also less, but wealth continues to increase.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: First House: Happiness. Due to the influence of Budha, the lord of the 2nd and 5th houses, situated in a friendly sign of Venus in the first house, the native is beautiful, renowned, famous, and possesses strength in family and wealth. Education, intelligence, and children also remain good. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the seventh house, success and support are also obtained in matters of spouse and business.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Sixth House: Due to the influence of Budha situated in a friendly sign of Venus in the sixth house, the native experiences unrest due to enemies, but also achieves success over them through their intelligence. There are also indications of differences and troubles with children and friends. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the twelfth house, there is a risk of wealth being stolen, but respect and wealth are gained through connections with foreign places.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Seventh House: Due to the influence of Budha situated in a friendly sign of Mars in the seventh house, the native gets an intelligent spouse, and also achieves success in the field of business. There are also indications of happiness and wealth from education, intellect, and children. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the first house, the native also gains physical beauty, fame, prestige, intelligence, discernment, wealth, and success.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Eighth House: Due to the influence of Budha situated in a friendly sign of Guru (Jupiter) in the eighth house, the native gains longevity and benefits from ancient knowledge/archeology, and the power of wealth accumulation increases. However, there are troubles regarding children, education, and friends. Due to the seventh aspect falling on the second house, its own sign, the native earns wealth through hard work. Such a person has a good standard of living.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: Ninth House: Due to the influence of Budha situated in a friendly sign of Shani (Saturn) in the ninth house, the native increases their fortune and wealth through intellectual yoga (combinations), and also attains happiness related to dharma (righteousness), education, and children.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: 9th House: Due to the influence of Budha (Mercury) situated in a friendly sign of Shani (Saturn) in the 9th house (Capricorn for Taurus Ascendant), the native increases his fortune and wealth through intelligence and yoga, and also attains happiness related to religion, knowledge, children, and other matters. Due to the 7th aspect on the 3rd house, the native gets happiness from siblings, and valor also increases significantly. Such a native is happy, wealthy, and majestic.

Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.subject: Daridra-yoga Yoga
Bhrigu_Samhita_deep.text: Taurus Ascendant: 10th House: Due to the influence of Budha (Mercury) situated in a friendly sign of Shani (Saturn) in the 10th house (Aquarius for Taurus Ascendant), the native gains special benefits and honor from father and government. He also earns sufficient financial gains from business through his intelligence. He is also happy regarding children. Due to the 7th aspect on the 4th house, the native gains happiness from mother, land, house, and family.

Similarly, if the lord of the 7th Navamsa does not aspect its own Navamsa or the 7th house, or is not conjoined with them, then it is inauspicious for the bride.

Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.text: Kasyapa says: 'If the lords of the Lagna or 7th Navamsa are not aspected or conjoined by their own lords, or if the Lagna or 7th house are not aspected or conjoined by their respective lords (of the navamsa), then (it is inauspicious).'

Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.text: Narada says: 'If the Lagna Navamsa and the 7th Navamsa are aspected or conjoined by their respective lords, or if not, by mutual lords or auspicious friends, then it is auspicious for the groom. Similarly, if both Lagna Navamsa and 7th Navamsa are aspected or conjoined, then it is auspicious for the bride's marriage.'

Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.text: Varaha says: 'Auspicious results occur if the Lagna Navamsa or the 7th Navamsa is associated with the Lagna, and if it is aspected by benefic planets, then it leads to auspiciousness, so say the wise.'

Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7

Also, planets situated in Kendra (angular), Trikona (trine), Aya (11th), or Dhana (2nd) houses.

Muhurtha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7

Prashna_Marga_deep.subject: House 8
Prashna_Marga_deep.text: If the lord of the 5th from the Lagna Dwadasamsa Rasi occupies the Lagna, a child will be born within a year. The child will be born in as many years as the number of the house the said lord is in, counted from the Lagna. If he occupies the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, no child will be born.

Prashna_Marga_deep.subject: House 8
Prashna_Marga_deep.text: The time of birth of a child is determined by the house position of the lord of the 5th from the Dwadasamsa Rasi of the Lagna. The child will be born in as many years as the house number from Lagna. If in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, or 5th, the child will be born in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, or 5th year respectively. If in the 7th, 9th, 10th, or 11th, the child will be born after remedial measures. If in the 6th, 8th, or 12th, no child will be born.

The child will be born in as many years as the house number from Lagna. If in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, or 5th, the child will be born in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, or 5th year respectively. If in the 7th, 9th, 10th, or 11th, the child will be born after remedial measures. If in the 6th, 8th, or 12th, no child will be born.

Raman_300Combinations_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Raman_300Combinations_deep.text: Amala Yoga is formed when a benefic planet occupies the 10th house from the Lagna (ascendant).

Raman_300Combinations_deep.subject: Amala Yoga
Raman_300Combinations_deep.text: In the interpretation of any combination, careful consideration must be given to the strength of the planet forming the Amala Yoga, along with its aspects and associations. A benefic planet must occupy the 10th house from either the Lagna or the Moon for Amala Yoga to manifest; if no benefic is present, Amala is not formed. However, based on the dictum “tvamq ead aft trerewateaa: | aa wrest: wi sag WHEAT ||,” which states that any planet in the 10th from Lagna or Moon will yield substantial wealth during its Dasa period, even malefics are not entirely ruled out for providing wealth. 'Amala' signifies purity, meaning that when this Yoga is present, prosperity and affluence are attained through ethical means. A malefic in the 10th, while potentially bringing wealth, may lead to questionable methods, and would not confer fame or good character, unlike Amala Yoga.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Results of the Eighth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Topics to consider in the Eighth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Kṣīra (milk), Guḍa (jaggery), Ghūjakka, Salt, Gadya (speech), Rabha, Maraṇāntakāyu (death, end, longevity) (names for 8th house). Kṣamā (forgiveness), Dayā (compassion), Pānaka, Bhāgya (fortune), Guru (teacher), Tapas (penance), Lābha (gain), Śubhājitāni (auspicious and unconquered) (names for 9th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Planets located in evil houses (6, 8, 12) become without influence (nashtaprabhava).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: A planet in the houses 8, 12, or 6 from the Pākeśa (dasha lord/sign lord) gives favorable results, along with gain and children. Or, a planet associated with 'shobhana' in the 10th house is auspicious. The 'kāmānvita khecara' (planet associated with desires) gives inauspicious results. This is the order. (Commentary clarifies: A planet in houses 8, 12, 6 from the Pākeśa is considered 'mitra' (friendly). A planet in the 7th house gives inauspicious results. This is the order of planets.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Lagna (Ascendant) and other house lords, when in the 6th, 8th, 12th houses, and malefic planets in these houses give inauspicious results. Benefic planets do not give results, but also do not cause inauspicious results. The results of each house are stated thus.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of any house is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th (evil houses), or if the lord of an evil house is situated in a particular house, then astrologers say that the result of that house is destroyed. If that house is aspected by a benefic planet, then there is happiness related to that house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If a planet is in a destructive house (8th), or is combust, or if the lord of a sign is debilitated or in an enemy sign, or if it is not conjoined with benefic planets, then the sages say that the destruction of that house occurs. Even if a house is conjoined with a planet, if it has the aforementioned characteristics, it does not give auspicious results. This is applicable to all houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The effects arising from these lords are said to be half in their opinion. During the main periods of planets in 6th or 8th from each other, there is loss of place and especially death.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The seed of intellect here is the lord of the sign and Navamsa conjoined with the 8th lord.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if dry planets are situated in a house, or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (nāśagate) in a dry sign, then the body suffers greatly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If (the Ascendant lord) is debilitated and conjoined (with malefic), and also in a malefic house, then the same result (emaciation). If the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house and in a dry sign, then the body is lean and suffers greatly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 2nd lord (Dhanesha) is in the 8th house (Nāśarāśi), associated with malefics, and debilitated, and conjoined with a royal significator (Rajyakaraka), then there is loss of wealth due to royal punishment.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 2nd (Dhana) and 12th (Vyaya) houses exchange places (Nyayavittasaṁstho), and are aspected by the Ascendant lord (Lagneshvara), or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (Nāśagate) with malefics, then there is loss of wealth due to the anger of the king. If the lord of the 10th house (Karmesha) goes to the 11th house (Labha) and is conjoined with the Ascendant lord, or in certain malefic divisions (Yamakantaka), there is loss of wealth due to the king's anger.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If FA BHT FIST aspected, in malefic amsa, Is, conjoined with malefics, and eighth lord etc. Fa conjoined, then loss of wealth from thieves or king is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the tenth lord is conjoined with malefics in the eighth house, especially in cruel etc. paṣṭaryaṁśakarmē, and the lord of wealth is aay conjoined, then loss of wealth due to public defamation (false accusation) is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in a debilitated sign, and a malefic is in the 2nd house (Dhana) and the 8th house (Randhra), then one becomes indebted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is combust (astangata), debilitated (nīcharāśigata), and the 2nd or 8th house is afflicted by malefic planets, then the person remains indebted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the fourth house is in a malefic Shashtiamsha, or if there is a malefic in the fourth house, or if the fourth house is in a debilitated sign, or in a malefic house (Duhsthanas - 6th, 8th, 12th), or in a dreadful Navamsha, then astrologers say there will be destruction of land and property.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 4th house (चतुरयैश - likely OCR for चतुर्थेश) is in the 8th house, then one builds a house for himself.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If many malefic planets are in the 7th house, or in the 6th or 8th house, associated with a cruel shashtyamsha, then urinary disorders should be predicted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Life and death from death, secret places, and cause of death; enjoyment, loss, bite, and defeat should also be considered from the 8th house by the wise.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is associated with malefic planets, and is in the 8th or 6th house, then they say this person has a short life. If associated with the lord of the Ascendant, then also short life, say the sages.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in its own sign, then the great sages declare long life. Special longevity is to be spoken if it is in its own sign, a friendly sign, or an exalted sign.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th is associated with the lord of the Ascendant, or if it is in an enemy sign, or associated with the lord of the 12th house, or if the lord of the 6th house is aspected by benefics, then long life is predicted for him, if (the combination) is aspected by benefics.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Even from the lord of the 10th house, longevity should be considered; long life if it is in its own house or exalted. If the lords of the 10th, Ascendant, and 8th houses are situated in Kendra (angular) houses, then they declare long life.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 10th house is in the 8th house or a movable sign, then at the time of death, his father will be far away. If (the lord of the 10th house is) in a fixed or dual nature sign, then at that time his father will be near.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there are benefic planets in the 8th house, and they are aspected by benefic planets, then one will remain happy. Similarly, due to association with malefics, coarse food is obtained, and due to association with benefics, fine food is obtained.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there is association or aspect of benefic planets on the 8th house, then there will be no humiliation. If the 8th house is a movable sign and its lord is also in a movable sign, then death will be in a foreign land.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 8th house is a fixed sign and its lord is also in a fixed sign or fixed Amsa, then death will be in one's own home.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 8th house is a dual nature sign, then death will occur on the road (during travel).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Consideration of the Results of the Eighth and Ninth Houses', in the commentary of Mahodhara's Sarvarthachintamani. || 7 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If 2nd and 12th houses are afflicted by malefics, or if malefics are in 2, 12, 6, or 8 houses, then the child dies quickly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If born when the 6th, 8th, or 12th house is occupied, or at the junction of signs, death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: And if malefics aspect it (the combination mentioned in 32.1) or if it is in the 8th house, then the child lives for 8 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
