Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the 1st, 8th, or 7th house, and benefic planets are outside the Kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), then death occurs in the 28th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in a Kendra (angular house) and any planet is in the 8th house, and benefics are not in Kendras, and malefic planets are present, then death occurs in the 22nd year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 8th lord and a malefic planet are together and not conjoined with benefics, then death occurs in the 37th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the 9th, 2nd, or 1st house, and the lord of the ascendant is in the 8th house with malefics, even if aspected by benefics, the native lives for only 24 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the ascendant and the lord of the ascendant is devoid of strength, then the native lives for 30 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Results of the Tenth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Topics to consider in the Tenth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Ājñā (command), Māna (honor), Daśama (tenth house), Karma (work), Tadāspada (abode), Kha (sky/space), Ghanalābhamāyam (wealth, gain, income) (names for 10th and 11th houses). Vyaya (expenditure), Antyama (last/end), Riph (loss), Vināśasaṃjña (named for destruction) (names for 12th house). Thus it is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Vyoma (sky/10th), Asta (setting/7th), Pātāla (underworld/4th), Birumāna (?) are names (for angles). Kaṇṭaka (angles), Catusthatha (quadrants) are also named. Tatśvanavāṃśakāstu (?).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The names of the Lagna (1st), 7th, 4th, and 10th houses are Kaṇṭaka (angles) and Kendra (quadrants). When a sign is in its own Navamsa, it is called Vargottama.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: They say: Aquatic signs (Capricorn) in the latter half, and 11th, 12th, 4th houses; animal signs (Aries, Taurus, Leo, first half of Capricorn, latter half of Sagittarius) in the 10th house; human signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, first half of Sagittarius) in the Lagna (1st house); and insect/watery signs (Cancer, Scorpio) in the 7th house are strong. They become weak in their 7th (opposition). The intermediate strengths are known by proportion.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Human signs are strong during the day, animal signs are strong during the night, and insect-like signs are strong during both twilight periods. The 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 11th houses are known as Upachaya houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: A planet in the houses 8, 12, or 6 from the Pākeśa (dasha lord/sign lord) gives favorable results, along with gain and children. Or, a planet associated with 'shobhana' in the 10th house is auspicious. The 'kāmānvita khecara' (planet associated with desires) gives inauspicious results. This is the order. (Commentary clarifies: A planet in houses 8, 12, 6 from the Pākeśa is considered 'mitra' (friendly). A planet in the 7th house gives inauspicious results. This is the order of planets.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of any house is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th (evil houses), or if the lord of an evil house is situated in a particular house, then astrologers say that the result of that house is destroyed. If that house is aspected by a benefic planet, then there is happiness related to that house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From whichever house, if benefic planets are in Trikona (5th, 9th), 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th houses and malefic planets are not present, or if it is conjoined with the lord of the house and not conjoined with malefic planets, then that house brings complete auspicious results. Conversely, if it is opposite (malefic present, benefic not), then that house is destroyed, or mixed results occur. This consideration applies to all houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Astrologers state the livelihood of planets: If the lord of the 10th house is in a specific Navamsa, then livelihood comes from medicines, gold, conveyances, shops, pearls, gems, reliance on others, travel, teaching mantras, alchemy, disputes, entertainment, and royal patronage. This is stated by astrologers according to Puranas and all Shastras.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics are in the 2nd, 10th houses from Niseka Lagna, or if there are masculine planets in masculine navamsa at the time of Niseka, then it is a male birth; otherwise, a female birth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are strong, benefic planets are weak, and neuter planets are in the 10th house or aspected by them, then astrologers declare birth as a eunuch.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 9th and 10th houses are in evil houses (Duḥsthāna), and the Lagna lord is strong, then a person is born without the sacraments (like Seemantonnayana, sacred fire rituals), even if he is a Brahmin's son.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The direction of the door is determined by the lord of Navamsa, or the lord of the 5th house, or the direction of a strong planet, or the direction of a planet in a Kendra (angular house), or the direction of the decanate sign, or the direction of the lord of the 10th house. Among these options, the direction of the strongest is to be declared.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The Upasutika (attendant at birth) should be declared according to the planet situated in the 9th, 4th (or 14th if not a typo), or 10th house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th) or in the 11th house, or exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th, 11th), and is very strong, and the lord of the sign where the second house lord is situated is in a Kendra house, then the native becomes the king of all people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is in a Kendra, in its exaltation sign, or in a friendly sign, or in its own division, or in Gopurāṃśa, then the native has a cheerful face and is wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the eleventh house is conjoined with the lord of wealth (second house lord), and is aspected by the lord of the tenth house, and is in Vaisheshikamsa, and in Pramochchakaramsa, then there will be great gain of wealth, say the excellent acharyas.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is conjoined with the lord of the eleventh house and the ascendant lord, and is in a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house, and is aspected by benefic planets, and is strong with temporal strength, then the person gains wealth through their own effort in middle age.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if the lord of the 11th house (Labhesha) and its significator (karaka graha) are associated with the lord of wealth (Dhanesha), or aspected by it, then there will be much wealth. (Hindi explanation also states that if Dhanesha and Dasamesha (10th lord) and its karaka are associated, wealth comes from father and king. And also, if the lord of 10th house is associated with Rajyakaraka (royal significator), wealth from self-giving and reputation.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 2nd (Dhana) and 12th (Vyaya) houses exchange places (Nyayavittasaṁstho), and are aspected by the Ascendant lord (Lagneshvara), or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (Nāśagate) with malefics, then there is loss of wealth due to the anger of the king. If the lord of the 10th house (Karmesha) goes to the 11th house (Labha) and is conjoined with the Ascendant lord, or in certain malefic divisions (Yamakantaka), there is loss of wealth due to the king's anger.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the tenth lord is conjoined with malefics in the eighth house, especially in cruel etc. paṣṭaryaṁśakarmē, and the lord of wealth is aay conjoined, then loss of wealth due to public defamation (false accusation) is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsa in which the lord of the twelfth house (Vyaya Bhava Lord) is situated, if its lord is conjoined with MATT lord of wealth, or aspected, debilitated or combust, weak, conjoined with malefics, and in a kendra (angular) house, then the person becomes devoid of wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha lord, and is debilitated or combust, then the person has little wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the houses of gains (11th), ascendant (1st), and wealth (2nd) are in Navamsas conjoined with benefics, and are in Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) houses, then the person becomes wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in Vesheshikamsha, in its exaltation or Mulatrikona sign, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha, then the lord of gains causes complete destruction. If a person born wealthy has destruction in Vesheshikamsha, and the lord of wealth is in cruel shashtyamsha, and also in Kendra, then...

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Saptamsa is with the lord of the Drekkan of the 10th house (Karmaśa), and is endowed with Airavatamsa, then one enjoys one lakh (100,000) wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics are in all four Kendras, and the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in Simhasanamsa or Paravatamsa, then one obtains three lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Vittapah) and the lord of the 11th house (Labhapati) are in Kendra houses and are strong, then one obtains more than one lakh wealth. If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah) is similarly placed, the same result is known.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah - inferred) is strong in a Kendra or Kona house, or conjoined with the lord of the 11th house (Labhanath - inferred), and is in Vaishakshamsa, then one obtains one lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: One becomes indebted if a malefic is in the 2nd house (Dhana) and conjoined with the 12th house (Vyaya), especially if the lord of the 10th house (Karmaśa) is aspected by the lord of the 11th house (Lābhanātha).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsha where the lords of the 10th and 6th houses are situated is in a bad house (Duḥstha), and similarly, if the lord of the Ascendant is conjoined (with malefic influences), and if the lord of the 10th house is in a destructive house, and if benefic planets do not aspect them, then there will be eye defects/afflictions.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the fourth house is strong in its own house in Paravatamsa, or in Upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11), or exalted, and aspected by a benefic, then there will be much land/agriculture.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the tenth house is in the fourth house with a malefic, or in a malefic Navamsha such as Mrityuyama, then there will be loss of land due to royal decree (or breaking rules).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the tenth house, or its significator, or the lord of the fourth house, is in a malefic Navamsha, or in Avarohabhaga, or in the house of destruction (Vyaya Sthana - 12th house), or in Mrityuyama, then there will be loss of land due to royal decree.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If an exalted planet is in the 10th house (उच्चाहये - likely OCR for उच्चस्थे) and aspected by the lord of the 9th house (भाग्यनाथेन), then one becomes the owner of vehicles.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 10th (कर्म), 6th (षट्), 3rd (सोदर), 4th (सुख), 9th (भाग्य), 1st (लग्न), and 12th (व्यय) houses are associated with the lord of the 5th house (सुताधिपेन), then one becomes the owner of countless vehicles in his own country.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 6th house is in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th house) and aspected by malefic planets, or if there are many malefics in the 6th house, then 'Shira-Pida' (headache) should be declared.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, in its exaltation, friendly sign, or own Varga (division), or conjoined with the lord of the 10th house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is in the 7th house, the lord of the 7th house is in the 4th house, or the lord of the 4th house or the lord of the 11th house are in a Kendra (angular) house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in Gopuramsha, and the lord of the 10th house is in the 7th house, and similarly the lord of the 2nd house is also in Gopuramsha, then the native will have ten wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a benefic sign or amsha (division), or the Karaka (for spouse) is similarly placed, and the 10th lord is strong, then the native will have a good wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Even from the lord of the 10th house, longevity should be considered; long life if it is in its own house or exalted. If the lords of the 10th, Ascendant, and 8th houses are situated in Kendra (angular) houses, then they declare long life.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 10th house is in the 8th house or a movable sign, then at the time of death, his father will be far away. If (the lord of the 10th house is) in a fixed or dual nature sign, then at that time his father will be near.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From the tenth house, one should consider (Karma's inclination), authority, fame, rain, journey, charitable deeds (like wells, ponds, etc.), status, what kind of livelihood will be, (Pitrsthāna etc.), and the consideration of the place of honour (Maana Sthana), and the consideration of servants.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 10th lord is in Goopuraamsa, or associated with benefic aspects, and also aspected by the 9th lord, then the person builds wells, ponds, land, etc.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 10th lord is exalted but afflicted by malefics, in a debilitated Navamsa, or in a destructive house, then a Brahmin (priest) will certainly be involved in his Yajna. The same result occurs if the 10th lord is in a cruel house from the 6th house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Drekkana occupied by the eleventh lord is a benefic, and the lord of the tenth house aspects it, then declare acquisition of wealth. || 7 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 12th house is aspected by a malefic 10th lord, and located in a debilitated or malefic amsha, then there is loss of wealth due to sinful acts.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 12th house is conjoined with a benefic 10th lord, and located in its exaltation, friendly, or own varga (sign or navamsa), then there is loss of wealth due to righteous deeds.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the 1st, 8th, or 7th house, and benefic planets are outside the Kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), then death occurs in the 28th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in a Kendra (angular house) and any planet is in the 8th house, and benefics are not in Kendras, and malefic planets are present, then death occurs in the 22nd year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant is extremely strong, conjoined with or aspected by benefics, and located in a Kendra, and free from malefic aspects, then the native is fortunate and lives long.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 10
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Ascendant (Janmadhipa) is in a Kendra (angular house) and is a benefic, or aspected by benefics, it protects the native.॥ 10॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Results of the Eighth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Topics to consider in the Eighth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Kṣīra (milk), Guḍa (jaggery), Ghūjakka, Salt, Gadya (speech), Rabha, Maraṇāntakāyu (death, end, longevity) (names for 8th house). Kṣamā (forgiveness), Dayā (compassion), Pānaka, Bhāgya (fortune), Guru (teacher), Tapas (penance), Lābha (gain), Śubhājitāni (auspicious and unconquered) (names for 9th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Planets located in evil houses (6, 8, 12) become without influence (nashtaprabhava).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: A planet in the houses 8, 12, or 6 from the Pākeśa (dasha lord/sign lord) gives favorable results, along with gain and children. Or, a planet associated with 'shobhana' in the 10th house is auspicious. The 'kāmānvita khecara' (planet associated with desires) gives inauspicious results. This is the order. (Commentary clarifies: A planet in houses 8, 12, 6 from the Pākeśa is considered 'mitra' (friendly). A planet in the 7th house gives inauspicious results. This is the order of planets.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Lagna (Ascendant) and other house lords, when in the 6th, 8th, 12th houses, and malefic planets in these houses give inauspicious results. Benefic planets do not give results, but also do not cause inauspicious results. The results of each house are stated thus.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of any house is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th (evil houses), or if the lord of an evil house is situated in a particular house, then astrologers say that the result of that house is destroyed. If that house is aspected by a benefic planet, then there is happiness related to that house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If a planet is in a destructive house (8th), or is combust, or if the lord of a sign is debilitated or in an enemy sign, or if it is not conjoined with benefic planets, then the sages say that the destruction of that house occurs. Even if a house is conjoined with a planet, if it has the aforementioned characteristics, it does not give auspicious results. This is applicable to all houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The effects arising from these lords are said to be half in their opinion. During the main periods of planets in 6th or 8th from each other, there is loss of place and especially death.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The seed of intellect here is the lord of the sign and Navamsa conjoined with the 8th lord.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if dry planets are situated in a house, or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (nāśagate) in a dry sign, then the body suffers greatly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If (the Ascendant lord) is debilitated and conjoined (with malefic), and also in a malefic house, then the same result (emaciation). If the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house and in a dry sign, then the body is lean and suffers greatly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 2nd lord (Dhanesha) is in the 8th house (Nāśarāśi), associated with malefics, and debilitated, and conjoined with a royal significator (Rajyakaraka), then there is loss of wealth due to royal punishment.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 2nd (Dhana) and 12th (Vyaya) houses exchange places (Nyayavittasaṁstho), and are aspected by the Ascendant lord (Lagneshvara), or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (Nāśagate) with malefics, then there is loss of wealth due to the anger of the king. If the lord of the 10th house (Karmesha) goes to the 11th house (Labha) and is conjoined with the Ascendant lord, or in certain malefic divisions (Yamakantaka), there is loss of wealth due to the king's anger.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If FA BHT FIST aspected, in malefic amsa, Is, conjoined with malefics, and eighth lord etc. Fa conjoined, then loss of wealth from thieves or king is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the tenth lord is conjoined with malefics in the eighth house, especially in cruel etc. paṣṭaryaṁśakarmē, and the lord of wealth is aay conjoined, then loss of wealth due to public defamation (false accusation) is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in a debilitated sign, and a malefic is in the 2nd house (Dhana) and the 8th house (Randhra), then one becomes indebted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is combust (astangata), debilitated (nīcharāśigata), and the 2nd or 8th house is afflicted by malefic planets, then the person remains indebted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the fourth house is in a malefic Shashtiamsha, or if there is a malefic in the fourth house, or if the fourth house is in a debilitated sign, or in a malefic house (Duhsthanas - 6th, 8th, 12th), or in a dreadful Navamsha, then astrologers say there will be destruction of land and property.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 4th house (चतुरयैश - likely OCR for चतुर्थेश) is in the 8th house, then one builds a house for himself.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If many malefic planets are in the 7th house, or in the 6th or 8th house, associated with a cruel shashtyamsha, then urinary disorders should be predicted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Life and death from death, secret places, and cause of death; enjoyment, loss, bite, and defeat should also be considered from the 8th house by the wise.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is associated with malefic planets, and is in the 8th or 6th house, then they say this person has a short life. If associated with the lord of the Ascendant, then also short life, say the sages.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in its own sign, then the great sages declare long life. Special longevity is to be spoken if it is in its own sign, a friendly sign, or an exalted sign.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th is associated with the lord of the Ascendant, or if it is in an enemy sign, or associated with the lord of the 12th house, or if the lord of the 6th house is aspected by benefics, then long life is predicted for him, if (the combination) is aspected by benefics.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Even from the lord of the 10th house, longevity should be considered; long life if it is in its own house or exalted. If the lords of the 10th, Ascendant, and 8th houses are situated in Kendra (angular) houses, then they declare long life.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 10th house is in the 8th house or a movable sign, then at the time of death, his father will be far away. If (the lord of the 10th house is) in a fixed or dual nature sign, then at that time his father will be near.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there are benefic planets in the 8th house, and they are aspected by benefic planets, then one will remain happy. Similarly, due to association with malefics, coarse food is obtained, and due to association with benefics, fine food is obtained.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there is association or aspect of benefic planets on the 8th house, then there will be no humiliation. If the 8th house is a movable sign and its lord is also in a movable sign, then death will be in a foreign land.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 8th house is a fixed sign and its lord is also in a fixed sign or fixed Amsa, then death will be in one's own home.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 8th house is a dual nature sign, then death will occur on the road (during travel).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Consideration of the Results of the Eighth and Ninth Houses', in the commentary of Mahodhara's Sarvarthachintamani. || 7 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If 2nd and 12th houses are afflicted by malefics, or if malefics are in 2, 12, 6, or 8 houses, then the child dies quickly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If born when the 6th, 8th, or 12th house is occupied, or at the junction of signs, death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: And if malefics aspect it (the combination mentioned in 32.1) or if it is in the 8th house, then the child lives for 8 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the 1st, 8th, or 7th house, and benefic planets are outside the Kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), then death occurs in the 28th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in a Kendra (angular house) and any planet is in the 8th house, and benefics are not in Kendras, and malefic planets are present, then death occurs in the 22nd year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 8th lord and a malefic planet are together and not conjoined with benefics, then death occurs in the 37th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the 9th, 2nd, or 1st house, and the lord of the ascendant is in the 8th house with malefics, even if aspected by benefics, the native lives for only 24 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 8
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the ascendant and the lord of the ascendant is devoid of strength, then the native lives for 30 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Results of the Seventh House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Considerations in the Seventh House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Rasātala, Veśya, Pātāla, Hrida, Raṇa, Mātu are names (for 4th house). Buddhiprasava, Atmaja (children), Mantra (counsel), Vivekashakti (discriminative power) are (names for 5th house). Disease, injury, enemy, calamity, the place of thieves, obstacles may happen here (for 6th house). Chittottha (love), Kāma (desire), Madana (Cupid), Kala, Dadhi (curd), Sūpa (names for 7th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Vyoma (sky/10th), Asta (setting/7th), Pātāla (underworld/4th), Birumāna (?) are names (for angles). Kaṇṭaka (angles), Catusthatha (quadrants) are also named. Tatśvanavāṃśakāstu (?).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The names of the Lagna (1st), 7th, 4th, and 10th houses are Kaṇṭaka (angles) and Kendra (quadrants). When a sign is in its own Navamsa, it is called Vargottama.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Aquatic, animal, and human-like signs are strong in their own divisions (or houses). Progressively, they become weak in the 7th house (opposition) or its equivalent. (Note: The OCR is highly corrupted, 'बधो माने' might be 'वीर्य मान' (strength/power) and 'मदे चापि' could be 'मेषे चापि' (in Aries) or related to strength. The transliteration and translation are best effort due to corruption).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: They say: Aquatic signs (Capricorn) in the latter half, and 11th, 12th, 4th houses; animal signs (Aries, Taurus, Leo, first half of Capricorn, latter half of Sagittarius) in the 10th house; human signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, first half of Sagittarius) in the Lagna (1st house); and insect/watery signs (Cancer, Scorpio) in the 7th house are strong. They become weak in their 7th (opposition). The intermediate strengths are known by proportion.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Based on commentary) In the 7th house from its Digbala position, a planet is devoid of directional strength. In between, it is proportional. Planets are strong during their own months, own hora, own day, and own year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: A planet in the houses 8, 12, or 6 from the Pākeśa (dasha lord/sign lord) gives favorable results, along with gain and children. Or, a planet associated with 'shobhana' in the 10th house is auspicious. The 'kāmānvita khecara' (planet associated with desires) gives inauspicious results. This is the order. (Commentary clarifies: A planet in houses 8, 12, 6 from the Pākeśa is considered 'mitra' (friendly). A planet in the 7th house gives inauspicious results. This is the order of planets.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From whichever house, if benefic planets are in Trikona (5th, 9th), 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th houses and malefic planets are not present, or if it is conjoined with the lord of the house and not conjoined with malefic planets, then that house brings complete auspicious results. Conversely, if it is opposite (malefic present, benefic not), then that house is destroyed, or mixed results occur. This consideration applies to all houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Astrologers say that birth occurs in the fifth house from the Adhana Lagna. If there are benefics in the Adhana Lagna or if it is aspected by them, the child will be long-lived and endowed with wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The direction of the door is determined by the lord of Navamsa, or the lord of the 5th house, or the direction of a strong planet, or the direction of a planet in a Kendra (angular house), or the direction of the decanate sign, or the direction of the lord of the 10th house. Among these options, the direction of the strongest is to be declared.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: And in the 2nd, 12th, and 7th houses, as many and what kind of planets are present, so many and such other Upasutikas should be declared in that house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th) or in the 11th house, or exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th, 11th), and is very strong, and the lord of the sign where the second house lord is situated is in a Kendra house, then the native becomes the king of all people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is in a Kendra, in its exaltation sign, or in a friendly sign, or in its own division, or in Gopurāṃśa, then the native has a cheerful face and is wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is conjoined with the lord of the eleventh house and the ascendant lord, and is in a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house, and is aspected by benefic planets, and is strong with temporal strength, then the person gains wealth through their own effort in middle age.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if the lord of the 7th house (Kalatrapati) and its significator (Stree Karaka Graha - significator of wife) are associated with the strong lord of wealth (Dhanesha), or aspected by it in Vaishishikamsha, then the native obtains wealth from their wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsa in which the lord of the twelfth house (Vyaya Bhava Lord) is situated, if its lord is conjoined with MATT lord of wealth, or aspected, debilitated or combust, weak, conjoined with malefics, and in a kendra (angular) house, then the person becomes devoid of wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha lord, and is debilitated or combust, then the person has little wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the houses of gains (11th), ascendant (1st), and wealth (2nd) are in Navamsas conjoined with benefics, and are in Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) houses, then the person becomes wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in Vesheshikamsha, in its exaltation or Mulatrikona sign, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha, then the lord of gains causes complete destruction. If a person born wealthy has destruction in Vesheshikamsha, and the lord of wealth is in cruel shashtyamsha, and also in Kendra, then...

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant is in the Drekkan of another planet, conjoined with the Saptamesha (lord of the 7th house), and is in Vaishakshamsa, then one obtains ten thousand wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics are in all four Kendras, and the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in Simhasanamsa or Paravatamsa, then one obtains three lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Vittapah) and the lord of the 11th house (Labhapati) are in Kendra houses and are strong, then one obtains more than one lakh wealth. If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah) is similarly placed, the same result is known.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah - inferred) is strong in a Kendra or Kona house, or conjoined with the lord of the 11th house (Labhanath - inferred), and is in Vaishakshamsa, then one obtains one lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the navamsa occupied by the lord of the 7th house is aspected by benefics, or is in an auspicious navamsa, then one drinks good substances like jaggery and milk.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the significator of spouse is in the fourth house, or the lord of the fourth house is in the seventh house, or the lord of the fourth house and the lord of the seventh house are together or aspected by each other, then agriculture/wealth comes from the spouse.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 6th house is in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th house) and aspected by malefic planets, or if there are many malefics in the 6th house, then 'Shira-Pida' (headache) should be declared.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From the seventh house, consider marriage, wife, husband, dals, curd, jaggery, milk, arrival, departure, desire/lust, and also consider the thoughts about stolen wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The number of wives should be told by scholars according to the strength of the planets associated with the 2nd and 7th lords. Also, the number of wives should be told based on the planets associated with the sign in which the 7th lord is placed.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Whatever planets are with the lord of the seventh house in its own sign, the number of wives should be told according to them.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the seventh house is conjoined with malefic planets and the lord of the second house (family) is similarly afflicted, then there will be two wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the seventh house is conjoined with auspicious planets, or is in an enemy sign or debilitated, and malefic planets are in the seventh house, then two marriages are indicated.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the significator (karaka) of the seventh house is conjoined with a malefic planet, or is in a debilitated sign or debilitated amsha, or aspected by a malefic planet, then two marriages should be indicated.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there is a combination of malefic planets in the seventh house or the second house (family), and its lord is weak, then there will be a second wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the second house (family) or the seventh house, and the lord of the seventh is in a debilitated sign, combust, etc., then three wives will be obtained. In these yogas, there is a possibility of loss of wife or a third wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the seventh house is in a debilitated, combust, or enemy sign, or in a cruel Shashtiamsha (60th divisional chart), then there will be another wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsha where the lord of the seventh house is situated is in a debilitated, combust, or enemy sign or Navamsha, or is hemmed between malefic planets or aspected by malefic planets, then there will be another wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: In this manner, if the 2nd lord or the lord of the Navamsha where the Karaka (for spouse) is located, when the 7th house is between malefic planets and its lord is also between malefic planets, then the wife will be abandoned/destroyed.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, in its exaltation, friendly sign, or own Varga (division), or conjoined with the lord of the 10th house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 11th house and the lord of the 7th house are conjoined, or aspect each other, or are powerful, or are situated in a trine house, then there will be many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is in the 7th house, the lord of the 7th house is in the 4th house, or the lord of the 4th house or the lord of the 11th house are in a Kendra (angular) house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is conjoined with the lord of the Navamsha, and that lord is also conjoined with a benefic planet, and is strong in Paravatadi Amshas (divisions), then the native will have one hundred wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in Gopuramsha, and the lord of the 10th house is in the 7th house, and similarly the lord of the 2nd house is also in Gopuramsha, then the native will have ten wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: In this way, one should also consider for children etc. If the lord of the 7th house is conjoined with a malefic or the 7th house is conjoined with a malefic...

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in the amsha (division) of a malefic planet, then the native will have a bad wife. If the lord of the 7th house is in a bad sixty-division (ṣaṣṭyaṃśa), then the native will have a bad wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house and the Karaka (for spouse) are in a debilitated Navamsha or conjoined with a debilitated planet, and devoid of benefic aspects, then the native will have a vile wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is conjoined with a benefic, aspected by a benefic planet, or situated between benefic planets, then the native will have a good wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a benefic sign or amsha (division), or the Karaka (for spouse) is similarly placed, and the 10th lord is strong, then the native will have a good wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house and a planet are together, very close to AAA, then marriage happens in childhood. If `waa WARS JAAS` is close to the zodiac sign, then the same result is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (Kalatranātha) and the lord of the 2nd house (Kuṭumbādhipati) are in Pārāvatāṃśa etc., strong (`ea vachavān`), and the lord of the 1st house (Tanubhāvanātha) is in Mṛdvāṃśak (`wae mṛdvāṃśak`), then sages (`muniroga`) declare marriage in childhood.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (`kṛlanātha`) is weaker (`hīnabale`) than the lord of the Ascendant (`lmeśvara`), or in an enemy's divisional sign (`aribhāgāṃśa`), or combust (`astangata`), or in a debilitated divisional sign (`nīcāṃśaka`), or conjoined with a debilitated planet (`nīcasamanvite`), then one obtains a spouse of lower status.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From the lord of the 7th house (`karananāthāyād`) or from the 7th sign (`saptama rāśi`), one should declare (`vadedvā`) about `balūna sāsya samajātamāhaḥ` (corrupted term), and a well-behaved woman (`suśīlāṃ`) devoted to her husband (`patibhakticittām`). (Translation truncated as original Hindi is truncated).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Or, observing the condition of the lord of the second house, this result should be stated: If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are equal in strength, then the woman will be of a similar caste, beautiful, and devoted to her husband. || 72 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are enemies, then those related to marriage will be... If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are friends, then even those with little [power] will be his friends. || 73 || If the lord of the seventh house is also [an enemy or friend], then those relatives are enemies, and if friends, they become friends. ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From the lord of the seventh house, or the significator of the seventh house, or the strongest among them, one should determine [the wife's characteristics]. || 75 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The color of the woman should be determined from the strongest among the lord of the seventh house, the seventh sign, or the significator planet of the seventh house. || 75 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The constellation occupied by the lord of the seventh house, or the sign itself, or its exaltation/debilitation sign, or its vargottama, or its three dasha divisions, these are its considerations. || 77 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The sign of the seventh house is 1, the sign of the lord of the seventh house is 2, and its exaltation sign is 3. In this way, there are three types of signs related to the spouse. From these, one should consider and state about the woman. || 77 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: These three types of Kalatra Rashi (spouse-related signs), if conjoined with their lord, or if the lord of one is in another of these three, or if the lord of the seventh house is in a Rashi and its trine (9th or 5th house from it), they are called Kalatra Rashi. In these, one should also consider. If there are planets in these signs, there will be sons; if there are no planets, there will be no sons. || 78 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (assuming 'chramreśe' is a typo for 'saptameśe') is situated in a debilitated sign or similar, there will be such kissing. Also, with the lord of the 2nd house (as described), one becomes desirous of 'Bhaga-chumbana'.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a dry sign, or if the 7th house itself is a dry sign, then the private part will not be wet, so it is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the 7th house, and its lord is associated with malefic planets, or in a cruel shashtyamsha, then one eats food devoid of good pulses/vegetables.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If many malefic planets are in the 7th house, or in the 6th or 8th house, associated with a cruel shashtyamsha, then urinary disorders should be predicted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 12th house is aspected or conjoined by a weak lord of the 5th house, and is also in a cruel amsha, then there is loss of wealth due to children.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 2nd and 12th houses from Lagna are afflicted by malefics, or the 7th and 12th houses, then destruction (death) occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Hora (Ascendant) is in the 2nd house and defeated by a malefic in planetary war, it causes death. Multiplying the Rashi by three, death occurs in that many months or years, undoubtedly. ॥ 68 ॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If in the seventh house (pāpa-graha) afflicted by malefic planets in war, then undoubtedly, multiplying it by three, whatever is obtained, in that many months or years, one undoubtedly dies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the 1st, 8th, or 7th house, and benefic planets are outside the Kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), then death occurs in the 28th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in a Kendra (angular house) and any planet is in the 8th house, and benefics are not in Kendras, and malefic planets are present, then death occurs in the 22nd year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant is extremely strong, conjoined with or aspected by benefics, and located in a Kendra, and free from malefic aspects, then the native is fortunate and lives long.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 7
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Ascendant (Janmadhipa) is in a Kendra (angular house) and is a benefic, or aspected by benefics, it protects the native.॥ 10॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Hora, Tanu, Mrityudaya, Shira (names for 1st house); Vāgvitta, Kauṭumba, Akshi Saṃjñā (speech, wealth, family, eyes - names for 2nd house); Sahotya, Śaurya (courage), Karṇa (ear), Sukha (happiness), Ambu (water), Bandhu (relatives) (names for 3rd and 4th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics are in the 2nd, 10th houses from Niseka Lagna, or if there are masculine planets in masculine navamsa at the time of Niseka, then it is a male birth; otherwise, a female birth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics or masculine planets aspect the 5th, 9th, or 2nd houses from the Adhana Lagna, or if there is a masculine Navamsa, then it indicates the birth of a son. Conversely, if opposite planets aspect these houses (5, 9, 2) or if there is a feminine Navamsa, then it indicates the birth of a daughter.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: And in the 2nd, 12th, and 7th houses, as many and what kind of planets are present, so many and such other Upasutikas should be declared in that house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Now, the chapter on the results of the house of wealth (2nd house). From the second house, one should consider (related to oneself): people, face, speech, right eye, wealth, knowledge, specific enjoyments, servants, and friends.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is in Gopurāṃśaka or in Siṃhāsanāṃśaka, then (the native) protects fifty people. If the lord of the second house is in Gopurāṃśaka, or in the Navāṃśa of a planet, and is strong, and in Siṃhāsanāṃśaka, then (the native) protects fifty people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th) or in the 11th house, or exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th, 11th), and is very strong, and the lord of the sign where the second house lord is situated is in a Kendra house, then the native becomes the king of all people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is in a Kendra, in its exaltation sign, or in a friendly sign, or in its own division, or in Gopurāṃśa, then the native has a cheerful face and is wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the eleventh house is conjoined with the lord of wealth (second house lord), and is aspected by the lord of the tenth house, and is in Vaisheshikamsa, and in Pramochchakaramsa, then there will be great gain of wealth, say the excellent acharyas.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is conjoined with the lord of the eleventh house and the ascendant lord, and is in a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house, and is aspected by benefic planets, and is strong with temporal strength, then the person gains wealth through their own effort in middle age.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefic planets are in the second and eleventh houses, in exaltation or friendly signs, and in Vaisheshikamsa, or are strong, and are aspected by the lord of the Navamsha of the second house, then the person will gain great wealth in childhood itself.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant is in the second house, and the lord of the second house is in the eleventh house, or if the lord of the eleventh house is exalted, then there will be much wealth and valuable things.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsha in which a planet is situated, and the lord of the Rashi in which that Navamsha lord is situated, are powerful, and are friends of the lord of the second house, and are in a Kendra or Trikona house, or in their own sign, then the person gains wealth in many ways through their own valor and effort.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth (second house lord) and the lord of the ascendant are in the third house, powerful and conjoined or aspected by masculine planets, and also conjoined or aspected by the lord of the third house, and are in Vaisheshikamsa, then the person gains wealth from their brother.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the third house is in the second house (house of wealth), and a significator planet is also there, and it is conjoined or aspected by a powerful planet, and is in Vaisheshikamsa, then the person gains wealth from their brother.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: When the lord of the 2nd house (Vitteshwara) aspects the Ascendant lord (Lagnesha) or is conjoined with it, the native becomes wealthy by self-effort. If the lord of the 3rd house and its significator (karaka) are conjoined, then such a person obtains wealth. (Hindi explanation: If the 2nd lord aspects or is with the Lagnesha (lord of 1st house) in one house, the person becomes wealthy by their own effort. If the 3rd house lord and significator (karaka) are conjoined/aspected, then that specific result (wealth) will occur.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) and an auspicious divisional lord are situated or aspected (by 9th lord), and the lord of the 9th house (Navamesha) aspects them, then there will be much wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth (Vittapatau, 2nd lord) is conjoined or aspected by the lord of the 4th house (Chaturtesha), and is strong, then wealth is obtained from the mother. If in Vaishishikamsha (specific divisional chart), wealth is from relatives (Jnati) or agriculture.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth (Dhanesha, 2nd lord) is in the house of wealth (2nd house), conjoined or aspected, and a significator (karaka graha) is also there, or if the lord of the house of brothers (3rd lord, based on context) is conjoined/aspected in Vaishishikamsha, then one obtains wealth from brothers.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 5th house (Putresha) and its significator (karaka graha) are associated with the strong lord of wealth (Vittapatau, 2nd lord), or if the strong Ascendant lord (Lagnesha) is conjoined or aspected in Vaishishikamsha, then one obtains wealth from self-earned efforts or through sons.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the Ascendant lord (Lagnesha) is in Vaishishikamsha, the native earns wealth from their own sons. Similarly, if the lord of the 6th house (Ṣaṣṭheśa) and its significator are associated with the strong lord of wealth (Dhanesha), or aspects it, wealth is obtained from enemies (Shatru karaka graha).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if the lord of the 7th house (Kalatrapati) and its significator (Stree Karaka Graha - significator of wife) are associated with the strong lord of wealth (Dhanesha), or aspected by it in Vaishishikamsha, then the native obtains wealth from their wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if the lord of the 11th house (Labhesha) and its significator (karaka graha) are associated with the lord of wealth (Dhanesha), or aspected by it, then there will be much wealth. (Hindi explanation also states that if Dhanesha and Dasamesha (10th lord) and its karaka are associated, wealth comes from father and king. And also, if the lord of 10th house is associated with Rajyakaraka (royal significator), wealth from self-giving and reputation.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets (Pāpagrahāḥ) are strong in the 2nd house (Dhana Bhava), the native becomes wealthy. Even if planets are debilitated, in enemy signs, or combust in the 2nd house, if they are strong due to Vaishishikamsha or Yoga with Lagnesha, wealth can be obtained. However, if the lords of various houses (brothers, children, enemies, wife, etc.) are associated with malefic divisions, then there is loss of wealth through them. The good associations of these house lords bring wealth, while malefic associations bring loss of wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 2nd lord (Dhanesha) is in the 8th house (Nāśarāśi), associated with malefics, and debilitated, and conjoined with a royal significator (Rajyakaraka), then there is loss of wealth due to royal punishment.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 2nd (Dhana) and 12th (Vyaya) houses exchange places (Nyayavittasaṁstho), and are aspected by the Ascendant lord (Lagneshvara), or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (Nāśagate) with malefics, then there is loss of wealth due to the anger of the king. If the lord of the 10th house (Karmesha) goes to the 11th house (Labha) and is conjoined with the Ascendant lord, or in certain malefic divisions (Yamakantaka), there is loss of wealth due to the king's anger.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the tenth lord is conjoined with malefics in the eighth house, especially in cruel etc. paṣṭaryaṁśakarmē, and the lord of wealth is aay conjoined, then loss of wealth due to public defamation (false accusation) is said.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsa in which the lord of the twelfth house (Vyaya Bhava Lord) is situated, if its lord is conjoined with MATT lord of wealth, or aspected, debilitated or combust, weak, conjoined with malefics, and in a kendra (angular) house, then the person becomes devoid of wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha lord, and is debilitated or combust, then the person has little wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the houses of gains (11th), ascendant (1st), and wealth (2nd) are in Navamsas conjoined with benefics, and are in Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) houses, then the person becomes wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in Vesheshikamsha, in its exaltation or Mulatrikona sign, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha, then the lord of gains causes complete destruction. If a person born wealthy has destruction in Vesheshikamsha, and the lord of wealth is in cruel shashtyamsha, and also in Kendra, then...

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in the second house, conjoined with benefics in Navamsa, then the person is called wealthy, but may not have wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha), conjoined with the lord of the Drekkanesha, and with the lord of the Navamsa, is endowed with supreme strength, then one becomes the owner of eight thousand coins.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics are in all four Kendras, and the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in Simhasanamsa or Paravatamsa, then one obtains three lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: One becomes the owner of three lakh if the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) or the lord of the 11th house (Labhesha) is in Vaishakshamsa or Mridvamsa.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Vittapah) and the lord of the 11th house (Labhapati) are in Kendra houses and are strong, then one obtains more than one lakh wealth. If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah) is similarly placed, the same result is known.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: One becomes indebted if a malefic is in the 2nd house (Dhana) and conjoined with the 12th house (Vyaya), especially if the lord of the 10th house (Karmaśa) is aspected by the lord of the 11th house (Lābhanātha).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in a debilitated sign, and a malefic is in the 2nd house (Dhana) and the 8th house (Randhra), then one becomes indebted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 11th house is in the 12th house, especially if it is conjoined with or aspected by the lord of the 9th house or the lord of the 6th house, then the person remains afflicted by debt.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is combust (astangata), debilitated (nīcharāśigata), and the 2nd or 8th house is afflicted by malefic planets, then the person remains indebted.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dvitiyesha) is conjoined with enemies (malefics) and is in a debilitated sign, and its Navamsha lord is also conjoined with malefic planets, then dental diseases and falling of teeth will occur.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the house of speech (2nd house) is weak and in a Cruel Amsha (inauspicious divisional portion), then speech is afflicted by Vayu disease.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the house of speech (2nd house) is devoid of firmness (weak), then they say there is stammering in speech.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house and [unclear word, possibly related to speech or tongue] are in a cruel-aṃśa (inauspicious divisional part), then the tongue is afflicted by vata (wind) disease. If the [unclear word, possibly 'second'] is debilitated and aspected by malefics, then the speech is said to be unsteady.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: It is said: If the second house (dhana) is aspected by malefics, or if it is in an inauspicious aṃśa and especially conjoined with malefics, and that place is also aspected by malefics, then there will be administration of poison (viṣaprayogaḥ) or deception etc. (vaṃcanādeḥ).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the fourth house lord is afflicted by malefics and is in the second house, in a debilitated sign or enemy sign, then there will be destruction of land. If the fourth house lord is exalted but afflicted by malefics, then there will be sale of land.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The number of wives should be told by scholars according to the strength of the planets associated with the 2nd and 7th lords. Also, the number of wives should be told based on the planets associated with the sign in which the 7th lord is placed.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the seventh house is conjoined with malefic planets and the lord of the second house (family) is similarly afflicted, then there will be two wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there is a combination of malefic planets in the seventh house or the second house (family), and its lord is weak, then there will be a second wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the second house (family) or the seventh house, and the lord of the seventh is in a debilitated sign, combust, etc., then three wives will be obtained. In these yogas, there is a possibility of loss of wife or a third wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: In this manner, if the 2nd lord or the lord of the Navamsha where the Karaka (for spouse) is located, when the 7th house is between malefic planets and its lord is also between malefic planets, then the wife will be abandoned/destroyed.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house, being in a sign whose lord is conjoined with the lord of the 60th division (ṣaṣṭyaṃśa), is powerful and situated in Mudramsha or Gopuramsha, then the native will have two hundred wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in Gopuramsha, and the lord of the 10th house is in the 7th house, and similarly the lord of the 2nd house is also in Gopuramsha, then the native will have ten wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (Kalatranātha) and the lord of the 2nd house (Kuṭumbādhipati) are in Pārāvatāṃśa etc., strong (`ea vachavān`), and the lord of the 1st house (Tanubhāvanātha) is in Mṛdvāṃśak (`wae mṛdvāṃśak`), then sages (`muniroga`) declare marriage in childhood.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Or, observing the condition of the lord of the second house, this result should be stated: If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are equal in strength, then the woman will be of a similar caste, beautiful, and devoted to her husband. || 72 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: In this way, with the lord of the second house, one becomes a partaker of kissing [the vagina]. || 89 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: In this way, with the lord of the family (2nd house), one becomes kissed by the Bhaga (vulva).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (assuming 'chramreśe' is a typo for 'saptameśe') is situated in a debilitated sign or similar, there will be such kissing. Also, with the lord of the 2nd house (as described), one becomes desirous of 'Bhaga-chumbana'.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is in the eleventh house, or if the lord of the eleventh house is in the second house, or if they both are in mutual exchange, then declare acquisition of wealth. || 3 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the eleventh lord is a benefic, and the lord of the second house aspects it, then declare acquisition of wealth. || 6 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 2nd and 12th houses from Lagna are afflicted by malefics, or the 7th and 12th houses, then destruction (death) occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If 2nd and 12th houses are afflicted by malefics, or if malefics are in 2, 12, 6, or 8 houses, then the child dies quickly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Hora (Ascendant) is in the 2nd house and defeated by a malefic in planetary war, it causes death. Multiplying the Rashi by three, death occurs in that many months or years, undoubtedly. ॥ 68 ॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 2
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the 9th, 2nd, or 1st house, and the lord of the ascendant is in the 8th house with malefics, even if aspected by benefics, the native lives for only 24 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Results of the Ninth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Now the Ninth House.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Topics to consider in the Ninth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Kṣīra (milk), Guḍa (jaggery), Ghūjakka, Salt, Gadya (speech), Rabha, Maraṇāntakāyu (death, end, longevity) (names for 8th house). Kṣamā (forgiveness), Dayā (compassion), Pānaka, Bhāgya (fortune), Guru (teacher), Tapas (penance), Lābha (gain), Śubhājitāni (auspicious and unconquered) (names for 9th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From whichever house, if benefic planets are in Trikona (5th, 9th), 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th houses and malefic planets are not present, or if it is conjoined with the lord of the house and not conjoined with malefic planets, then that house brings complete auspicious results. Conversely, if it is opposite (malefic present, benefic not), then that house is destroyed, or mixed results occur. This consideration applies to all houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics or masculine planets aspect the 5th, 9th, or 2nd houses from the Adhana Lagna, or if there is a masculine Navamsa, then it indicates the birth of a son. Conversely, if opposite planets aspect these houses (5, 9, 2) or if there is a feminine Navamsa, then it indicates the birth of a daughter.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 9th and 10th houses are in evil houses (Duḥsthāna), and the Lagna lord is strong, then a person is born without the sacraments (like Seemantonnayana, sacred fire rituals), even if he is a Brahmin's son.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The Upasutika (attendant at birth) should be declared according to the planet situated in the 9th, 4th (or 14th if not a typo), or 10th house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th) or in the 11th house, or exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th, 11th), and is very strong, and the lord of the sign where the second house lord is situated is in a Kendra house, then the native becomes the king of all people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is conjoined with the lord of the eleventh house and the ascendant lord, and is in a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house, and is aspected by benefic planets, and is strong with temporal strength, then the person gains wealth through their own effort in middle age.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) and an auspicious divisional lord are situated or aspected (by 9th lord), and the lord of the 9th house (Navamesha) aspects them, then there will be much wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha lord, and is debilitated or combust, then the person has little wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the houses of gains (11th), ascendant (1st), and wealth (2nd) are in Navamsas conjoined with benefics, and are in Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) houses, then the person becomes wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the aforementioned planet (from verse 95) is in benefic Shashtyamsa, in the 9th or 11th house, is strong, and is in a favorable sign, and endowed with benefic Shashtyamsa, then one becomes the owner of three thousand.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Vittapah) and the lord of the 11th house (Labhapati) are in Kendra houses and are strong, then one obtains more than one lakh wealth. If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah) is similarly placed, the same result is known.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
