Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah - inferred) is strong in a Kendra or Kona house, or conjoined with the lord of the 11th house (Labhanath - inferred), and is in Vaishakshamsa, then one obtains one lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant Navamsa and the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyesha) are in Paramocha (highest exaltation) portions, and the lord of the 11th house (Labhesha) is in Vaishakshamsa, then one becomes a millionaire (owner of a crore).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 11th house is in the 12th house, especially if it is conjoined with or aspected by the lord of the 9th house or the lord of the 6th house, then the person remains afflicted by debt.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If an exalted planet is in the 10th house (उच्चाहये - likely OCR for उच्चस्थे) and aspected by the lord of the 9th house (भाग्यनाथेन), then one becomes the owner of vehicles.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 10th (कर्म), 6th (षट्), 3rd (सोदर), 4th (सुख), 9th (भाग्य), 1st (लग्न), and 12th (व्यय) houses are associated with the lord of the 5th house (सुताधिपेन), then one becomes the owner of countless vehicles in his own country.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 5th house or the 9th house is conjoined with an auspicious planet, and the sign lord also has an auspicious conjunction, then one is always ready to give food.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, in its exaltation, friendly sign, or own Varga (division), or conjoined with the lord of the 10th house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 11th house and the lord of the 7th house are conjoined, or aspect each other, or are powerful, or are situated in a trine house, then there will be many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is in the 7th house, the lord of the 7th house is in the 4th house, or the lord of the 4th house or the lord of the 11th house are in a Kendra (angular) house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: These three types of Kalatra Rashi (spouse-related signs), if conjoined with their lord, or if the lord of one is in another of these three, or if the lord of the seventh house is in a Rashi and its trine (9th or 5th house from it), they are called Kalatra Rashi. In these, one should also consider. If there are planets in these signs, there will be sons; if there are no planets, there will be no sons. || 78 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Also, Guru (teacher/preceptor), lord (acharya, etc.), father, etc., maternal uncle should be considered from this (9th house). If the 9th house is associated with its lord and benefic planets, then the above (significations) are good; otherwise (in other configurations) they are inauspicious.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is associated with such a planet (afflicted by malefics) and also afflicted by malefics, then one becomes a violator of the preceptor's wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the sign where the 9th lord is situated is similarly associated (as in previous verse with malefics), then one becomes a violator of the preceptor's wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there are many malefic conjunctions in the 9th house, or its lord is weak, or the Ascendant lord is weak, the person becomes unfortunate.॥ 36 ॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Consideration of the Results of the Eighth and Ninth Houses', in the commentary of Mahodhara's Sarvarthachintamani. || 7 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 10th lord is in Goopuraamsa, or associated with benefic aspects, and also aspected by the 9th lord, then the person builds wells, ponds, land, etc.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 12th house is conjoined with the lord of the 9th house (father) or its significator, or aspected by them, then there is loss of wealth due to father.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If all planets are in Apoklima houses (3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th) and devoid of strength, then the lifespan is said to be six months or two months.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the 9th, 2nd, or 1st house, and the lord of the ascendant is in the 8th house with malefics, even if aspected by benefics, the native lives for only 24 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Consideration of Lagna Bhava (Ascendant House)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The names of the Ascendant (1st house) are Hora, Tanu, Murti, Udaya, Shira.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Hora, Tanu, Mrityudaya, Shira (names for 1st house); Vāgvitta, Kauṭumba, Akshi Saṃjñā (speech, wealth, family, eyes - names for 2nd house); Sahotya, Śaurya (courage), Karṇa (ear), Sukha (happiness), Ambu (water), Bandhu (relatives) (names for 3rd and 4th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Vyoma (sky/10th), Asta (setting/7th), Pātāla (underworld/4th), Birumāna (?) are names (for angles). Kaṇṭaka (angles), Catusthatha (quadrants) are also named. Tatśvanavāṃśakāstu (?).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The names of the Lagna (1st), 7th, 4th, and 10th houses are Kaṇṭaka (angles) and Kendra (quadrants). When a sign is in its own Navamsa, it is called Vargottama.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: They say: Aquatic signs (Capricorn) in the latter half, and 11th, 12th, 4th houses; animal signs (Aries, Taurus, Leo, first half of Capricorn, latter half of Sagittarius) in the 10th house; human signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, first half of Sagittarius) in the Lagna (1st house); and insect/watery signs (Cancer, Scorpio) in the 7th house are strong. They become weak in their 7th (opposition). The intermediate strengths are known by proportion.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 9th and 10th houses are in evil houses (Duḥsthāna), and the Lagna lord is strong, then a person is born without the sacraments (like Seemantonnayana, sacred fire rituals), even if he is a Brahmin's son.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The direction of the door is determined by the lord of Navamsa, or the lord of the 5th house, or the direction of a strong planet, or the direction of a planet in a Kendra (angular house), or the direction of the decanate sign, or the direction of the lord of the 10th house. Among these options, the direction of the strongest is to be declared.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: When the Ascendant is of five Ghatis, then it is large, not half (small) from it.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the Ascendant is of five Ghatis, then the person has a large head. Half of that (duration) implies a small head.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Sages say that a large head (is indicated by a certain lagna duration); if less (duration in lagna), experts say the head is small. When a dry planet is in a dry sign, they say the body is emaciated (lean).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: A five-ghati Ascendant indicates a large head, half of that a small head, and a medium (duration) indicates a medium head. Astrologers say that a weak or dry (lagna?) with dry planets makes the body lean. Here, 'dry' implies signs other than watery signs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Similarly, if dry planets are situated in a house, or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (nāśagate) in a dry sign, then the body suffers greatly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If (the Ascendant lord) is debilitated and conjoined (with malefic), and also in a malefic house, then the same result (emaciation). If the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house and in a dry sign, then the body is lean and suffers greatly.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsa sign of the Ascendant is in a dry planet's house, they say the body is lean. If the Ascendant is in a dry sign and conjoined with many malefics, then also they say the body suffers.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the planet (lord of Navamsa sign of Ascendant) is in a sign/Navamsa of a planet which is weak or itself debilitated, then the body remains lean. If the Ascendant is conjoined with many malefics, then also they say the body is lean.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the Ascendant is in a watery sign and conjoined with benefic planets, they declare a fat body. If the Ascendant lord is strong and conjoined with benefics, they say the body is stout.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there is a watery sign in the Ascendant and benefic planets are there, they say the body is stout. If the Ascendant lord is strong and conjoined with benefics, they also say the body is stout.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If (the Ascendant) is in a watery sign, conjoined with benefics, and aspected by a watery planet, similarly if the Ascendant lord is in a benefic sign/house, or if the lord of the Navamsa sign of the Ascendant lord is (benefic), then also the same (stout body).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the Ascendant is in a watery sign, conjoined with benefics, and aspected by a watery planet, then the body is stout. If the Ascendant is in a watery sign, and the lord of the sign/Navamsa where the Ascendant lord is situated is a benefic, then also know the same (stout body).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th) or in the 11th house, or exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th, 11th), and is very strong, and the lord of the sign where the second house lord is situated is in a Kendra house, then the native becomes the king of all people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is in a Kendra, in its exaltation sign, or in a friendly sign, or in its own division, or in Gopurāṃśa, then the native has a cheerful face and is wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is conjoined with the lord of the eleventh house and the ascendant lord, and is in a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house, and is aspected by benefic planets, and is strong with temporal strength, then the person gains wealth through their own effort in middle age.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth (second house lord) and the lord of the ascendant are in the third house, powerful and conjoined or aspected by masculine planets, and also conjoined or aspected by the lord of the third house, and are in Vaisheshikamsa, then the person gains wealth from their brother.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: When the lord of the 2nd house (Vitteshwara) aspects the Ascendant lord (Lagnesha) or is conjoined with it, the native becomes wealthy by self-effort. If the lord of the 3rd house and its significator (karaka) are conjoined, then such a person obtains wealth. (Hindi explanation: If the 2nd lord aspects or is with the Lagnesha (lord of 1st house) in one house, the person becomes wealthy by their own effort. If the 3rd house lord and significator (karaka) are conjoined/aspected, then that specific result (wealth) will occur.)

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 5th house (Putresha) and its significator (karaka graha) are associated with the strong lord of wealth (Vittapatau, 2nd lord), or if the strong Ascendant lord (Lagnesha) is conjoined or aspected in Vaishishikamsha, then one obtains wealth from self-earned efforts or through sons.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the Ascendant lord (Lagnesha) is in Vaishishikamsha, the native earns wealth from their own sons. Similarly, if the lord of the 6th house (Ṣaṣṭheśa) and its significator are associated with the strong lord of wealth (Dhanesha), or aspects it, wealth is obtained from enemies (Shatru karaka graha).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 2nd (Dhana) and 12th (Vyaya) houses exchange places (Nyayavittasaṁstho), and are aspected by the Ascendant lord (Lagneshvara), or if the Ascendant lord is in the 8th house (Nāśagate) with malefics, then there is loss of wealth due to the anger of the king. If the lord of the 10th house (Karmesha) goes to the 11th house (Labha) and is conjoined with the Ascendant lord, or in certain malefic divisions (Yamakantaka), there is loss of wealth due to the king's anger.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsa in which the lord of the twelfth house (Vyaya Bhava Lord) is situated, if its lord is conjoined with MATT lord of wealth, or aspected, debilitated or combust, weak, conjoined with malefics, and in a kendra (angular) house, then the person becomes devoid of wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha lord, and is debilitated or combust, then the person has little wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the houses of gains (11th), ascendant (1st), and wealth (2nd) are in Navamsas conjoined with benefics, and are in Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) houses, then the person becomes wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in Vesheshikamsha, in its exaltation or Mulatrikona sign, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha, then the lord of gains causes complete destruction. If a person born wealthy has destruction in Vesheshikamsha, and the lord of wealth is in cruel shashtyamsha, and also in Kendra, then...

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics are in all four Kendras, and the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) is in Simhasanamsa or Paravatamsa, then one obtains three lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Vittapah) and the lord of the 11th house (Labhapati) are in Kendra houses and are strong, then one obtains more than one lakh wealth. If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah) is similarly placed, the same result is known.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah - inferred) is strong in a Kendra or Kona house, or conjoined with the lord of the 11th house (Labhanath - inferred), and is in Vaishakshamsa, then one obtains one lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Navamsha where the lords of the 10th and 6th houses are situated is in a bad house (Duḥstha), and similarly, if the lord of the Ascendant is conjoined (with malefic influences), and if the lord of the 10th house is in a destructive house, and if benefic planets do not aspect them, then there will be eye defects/afflictions.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 4th house is in the 12th house from the Ascendant, then enmity with the mother should be stated.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If an exalted planet is in the 10th house (उच्चाहये - likely OCR for उच्चस्थे) and aspected by the lord of the 9th house (भाग्यनाथेन), then one becomes the owner of vehicles.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 10th (कर्म), 6th (षट्), 3rd (सोदर), 4th (सुख), 9th (भाग्य), 1st (लग्न), and 12th (व्यय) houses are associated with the lord of the 5th house (सुताधिपेन), then one becomes the owner of countless vehicles in his own country.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 6th house is in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th house) and aspected by malefic planets, or if there are many malefics in the 6th house, then 'Shira-Pida' (headache) should be declared.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, in its exaltation, friendly sign, or own Varga (division), or conjoined with the lord of the 10th house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is in the 7th house, the lord of the 7th house is in the 4th house, or the lord of the 4th house or the lord of the 11th house are in a Kendra (angular) house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (Kalatranātha) and the lord of the 2nd house (Kuṭumbādhipati) are in Pārāvatāṃśa etc., strong (`ea vachavān`), and the lord of the 1st house (Tanubhāvanātha) is in Mṛdvāṃśak (`wae mṛdvāṃśak`), then sages (`muniroga`) declare marriage in childhood.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house (`kṛlanātha`) is weaker (`hīnabale`) than the lord of the Ascendant (`lmeśvara`), or in an enemy's divisional sign (`aribhāgāṃśa`), or combust (`astangata`), or in a debilitated divisional sign (`nīcāṃśaka`), or conjoined with a debilitated planet (`nīcasamanvite`), then one obtains a spouse of lower status.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Or, observing the condition of the lord of the second house, this result should be stated: If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are equal in strength, then the woman will be of a similar caste, beautiful, and devoted to her husband. || 72 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: There, if the lord of the ascendant is in an inimical sign, then those are his enemies, and others are then. || 74 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are enemies, then those related to marriage will be... If the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the seventh house are friends, then even those with little [power] will be his friends. || 73 || If the lord of the seventh house is also [an enemy or friend], then those relatives are enemies, and if friends, they become friends. ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is associated with malefic planets, and is in the 8th or 6th house, then they say this person has a short life. If associated with the lord of the Ascendant, then also short life, say the sages.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th is associated with the lord of the Ascendant, or if it is in an enemy sign, or associated with the lord of the 12th house, or if the lord of the 6th house is aspected by benefics, then long life is predicted for him, if (the combination) is aspected by benefics.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Even from the lord of the 10th house, longevity should be considered; long life if it is in its own house or exalted. If the lords of the 10th, Ascendant, and 8th houses are situated in Kendra (angular) houses, then they declare long life.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there are many malefic conjunctions in the 9th house, or its lord is weak, or the Ascendant lord is weak, the person becomes unfortunate.॥ 36 ॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If one is born during an eclipse (Pariveshakala) with the Lagna afflicted by malefics, and the Lagna lord is weak, then life is only for three fortnights or three months.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Hora (Ascendant) is in the 2nd house and defeated by a malefic in planetary war, it causes death. Multiplying the Rashi by three, death occurs in that many months or years, undoubtedly. ॥ 68 ॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the Lagna (ascendant) and all others are invisible, the child undoubtedly dies in the fourth month.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefic planets are in the 1st, 8th, or 7th house, and benefic planets are outside the Kendras (1, 4, 7, 10), then death occurs in the 28th year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in a Kendra (angular house) and any planet is in the 8th house, and benefics are not in Kendras, and malefic planets are present, then death occurs in the 22nd year.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the 9th, 2nd, or 1st house, and the lord of the ascendant is in the 8th house with malefics, even if aspected by benefics, the native lives for only 24 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the ascendant and the lord of the ascendant is devoid of strength, then the native lives for 30 years.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant is extremely strong, conjoined with or aspected by benefics, and located in a Kendra, and free from malefic aspects, then the native is fortunate and lives long.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 1
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the Ascendant (Janmadhipa) is in a Kendra (angular house) and is a benefic, or aspected by benefics, it protects the native.॥ 10॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Results of the Ninth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Now the Ninth House.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Topics to consider in the Ninth House

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Kṣīra (milk), Guḍa (jaggery), Ghūjakka, Salt, Gadya (speech), Rabha, Maraṇāntakāyu (death, end, longevity) (names for 8th house). Kṣamā (forgiveness), Dayā (compassion), Pānaka, Bhāgya (fortune), Guru (teacher), Tapas (penance), Lābha (gain), Śubhājitāni (auspicious and unconquered) (names for 9th house).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Temporary friends are those (planets) in the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses from a planet. Those situated in other houses become temporary enemies.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: From whichever house, if benefic planets are in Trikona (5th, 9th), 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th houses and malefic planets are not present, or if it is conjoined with the lord of the house and not conjoined with malefic planets, then that house brings complete auspicious results. Conversely, if it is opposite (malefic present, benefic not), then that house is destroyed, or mixed results occur. This consideration applies to all houses.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If benefics or masculine planets aspect the 5th, 9th, or 2nd houses from the Adhana Lagna, or if there is a masculine Navamsa, then it indicates the birth of a son. Conversely, if opposite planets aspect these houses (5, 9, 2) or if there is a feminine Navamsa, then it indicates the birth of a daughter.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 9th and 10th houses are in evil houses (Duḥsthāna), and the Lagna lord is strong, then a person is born without the sacraments (like Seemantonnayana, sacred fire rituals), even if he is a Brahmin's son.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: The Upasutika (attendant at birth) should be declared according to the planet situated in the 9th, 4th (or 14th if not a typo), or 10th house.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th) or in the 11th house, or exalted or in a trine (5th, 9th, 11th), and is very strong, and the lord of the sign where the second house lord is situated is in a Kendra house, then the native becomes the king of all people.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the second house is conjoined with the lord of the eleventh house and the ascendant lord, and is in a Trikona (5th or 9th) or Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) house, and is aspected by benefic planets, and is strong with temporal strength, then the person gains wealth through their own effort in middle age.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Dhanesha) and an auspicious divisional lord are situated or aspected (by 9th lord), and the lord of the 9th house (Navamesha) aspects them, then there will be much wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of wealth is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, conjoined with cruel shashtyamsha lord, and is debilitated or combust, then the person has little wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the houses of gains (11th), ascendant (1st), and wealth (2nd) are in Navamsas conjoined with benefics, and are in Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) houses, then the person becomes wealthy.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the aforementioned planet (from verse 95) is in benefic Shashtyamsa, in the 9th or 11th house, is strong, and is in a favorable sign, and endowed with benefic Shashtyamsa, then one becomes the owner of three thousand.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 2nd house (Vittapah) and the lord of the 11th house (Labhapati) are in Kendra houses and are strong, then one obtains more than one lakh wealth. If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah) is similarly placed, the same result is known.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyapah - inferred) is strong in a Kendra or Kona house, or conjoined with the lord of the 11th house (Labhanath - inferred), and is in Vaishakshamsa, then one obtains one lakh wealth.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the ascendant Navamsa and the lord of the 9th house (Bhagyesha) are in Paramocha (highest exaltation) portions, and the lord of the 11th house (Labhesha) is in Vaishakshamsa, then one becomes a millionaire (owner of a crore).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 11th house is in the 12th house, especially if it is conjoined with or aspected by the lord of the 9th house or the lord of the 6th house, then the person remains afflicted by debt.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If an exalted planet is in the 10th house (उच्चाहये - likely OCR for उच्चस्थे) and aspected by the lord of the 9th house (भाग्यनाथेन), then one becomes the owner of vehicles.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lords of the 10th (कर्म), 6th (षट्), 3rd (सोदर), 4th (सुख), 9th (भाग्य), 1st (लग्न), and 12th (व्यय) houses are associated with the lord of the 5th house (सुताधिपेन), then one becomes the owner of countless vehicles in his own country.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 5th house or the 9th house is conjoined with an auspicious planet, and the sign lord also has an auspicious conjunction, then one is always ready to give food.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: (Sanskrit) Head, mouth, throat, chest, nose, and anus; hands, sides, eyes, feet, soles of feet, and abdomen are indicated (as body parts related to houses). (Hindi explanation) The 6th house also considers diseases. Diseases caused by auspicious planets (or related to them) and malefic planets occur in the body parts associated with the 6th house. Therefore, the division of body parts is given: Head (1st house), Mouth (2nd house), Throat (3rd house), Ear (4th house), Nose (5th house), Anus (6th house), Hands (7th house), Sides (8th house), Eyes (9th house), Soles of feet (11th house), and Abdomen (12th house) - these are in क्रम (sequence).

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 7th house is in a Kendra (angular) or Trikona (trine) house, in its exaltation, friendly sign, or own Varga (division), or conjoined with the lord of the 10th house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 11th house and the lord of the 7th house are conjoined, or aspect each other, or are powerful, or are situated in a trine house, then there will be many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is in the 7th house, the lord of the 7th house is in the 4th house, or the lord of the 4th house or the lord of the 11th house are in a Kendra (angular) house, then one will have many wives.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: These three types of Kalatra Rashi (spouse-related signs), if conjoined with their lord, or if the lord of one is in another of these three, or if the lord of the seventh house is in a Rashi and its trine (9th or 5th house from it), they are called Kalatra Rashi. In these, one should also consider. If there are planets in these signs, there will be sons; if there are no planets, there will be no sons. || 78 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Also, Guru (teacher/preceptor), lord (acharya, etc.), father, etc., maternal uncle should be considered from this (9th house). If the 9th house is associated with its lord and benefic planets, then the above (significations) are good; otherwise (in other configurations) they are inauspicious.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 9th house is associated with such a planet (afflicted by malefics) and also afflicted by malefics, then one becomes a violator of the preceptor's wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the sign where the 9th lord is situated is similarly associated (as in previous verse with malefics), then one becomes a violator of the preceptor's wife.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If there are many malefic conjunctions in the 9th house, or its lord is weak, or the Ascendant lord is weak, the person becomes unfortunate.॥ 36 ॥

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Thus ends the seventh chapter, named 'Consideration of the Results of the Eighth and Ninth Houses', in the commentary of Mahodhara's Sarvarthachintamani. || 7 ||

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the 10th lord is in Goopuraamsa, or associated with benefic aspects, and also aspected by the 9th lord, then the person builds wells, ponds, land, etc.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 12th house is conjoined with the lord of the 9th house (father) or its significator, or aspected by them, then there is loss of wealth due to father.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If all planets are in Apoklima houses (3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th) and devoid of strength, then the lifespan is said to be six months or two months.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: Malefics in Kendra or Lagna or Trikona. Benefics in 6th and 8th.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If malefics are in Kendra, or 'Shani Chhamma' (Lagna/Saturn related, OCR broken), or Trikona, and malefics are also in 6, 8, 12 houses, then quick death occurs.

Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.subject: House 9
Sarvartha_Chintamani_deep.text: If the lord of the 8th house is in the 9th, 2nd, or 1st house, and the lord of the ascendant is in the 8th house with malefics, even if aspected by benefics, the native lives for only 24 years.
